activity: Making steel of legends scrolls during the the Amlodd Voice of Seren
image: [[File:Making steel of legends scrolls during the Amlodd Voice of Seren.png]]
details:
Steel Titan scroll (Steel of Legends)s provide an enormously powerful special attack for the steel titan, and they are often used while killing high-levelled monsters or in player killing. Because most players choose to buy these scrolls on the Grand Exchange instead of making them, there is lots of profit in turning steel titan pouches into scrolls.

To start off, buy steel titan pouches on the Grand Exchange. They have a buying limit of 5,000 per four hours. To save money, find the lowest price that others are buying the pouches for, and put in an offer slightly lower than theirs. It will take longer to fulfil, but it will greatly increase the profit.

The best way to make scrolls is at the Amlodd obelisk during the Amlodd Voice of Seren. Begin by summoning a Beast of Burden, and withdrawing 28 steel titan pouches into both your inventory and your beast of burden. Use the attuned crystal teleport seed to teleport to the Amlodd district, and run to the Obelisk. Use your pouches on the obelisk, and they will be made into scrolls. Withdraw from your beast of burden, and use your pouches on the obelisk again. Teleport to a bank by using TokKul-Zo (if you've completed The Elder Kiln) or a ring of duelling or the attuned crystal teleport seed (Ithell district). Bank your scrolls and repeat. Each run takes 17 seconds, so you can use around 9,137 pouches per hour using a Pack mammoth. This produces around 110,104 scrolls per hour.

You can decrease the travel time and increase the overall profit per hour by keybinding your Attuned crystal teleport seed as well as using the Surge ability with the Mobile perk.

After you've made all of your scrolls, sell them on the Grand Exchange. 
The efficiency of this method may depend on current market trends, so it would be wise to to try to maximise your profit by buying one of the scrolls instantly, and selling yours for slightly more than that.

Pale energy is usually in demand for those who create divine charges or augmentors. Level 1 Divination is required to harvest pale energy, but having level 5 gives a small increase in the amount of converted pale energy per pale memory. 

For maximum profit, convert all memories into energy (the first option). Converting memories to energy produces energies at approximately 2,273 per hour.

details:
Raw admiral pies are used to quickly train Cooking and Magic by using the Bake Pie spell. They are made by using the ingredients (Salmon, Tuna, Raw potato) on a Pie shell, in that order. To avoid losing money, test out the profit of making one pie before you do them in bulk.

Buy an equal number of pie shells, salmon, tuna and raw potatoes from the Grand Exchange (each has a buying limit of 1,000 per four hours). Withdraw 14 pie shells and 14 salmon, and use one on the other. This will bring up a menu to make part admiral pies, so click to make-all. Once you've made 14, bank them and repeat. When all of your salmon and pie shells are gone, use the tuna on the part summer pies in the same fashion, and then use the raw potatoes on the part admiral pies (tuna) to create raw admiral pies. Adding an ingredient 14 times will take about 20 seconds including banking, so you can make up to 840 raw admiral pies per hour.

You can then sell the pies on the Grand Exchange. To maximise your profit, buy one raw admiral pie at the instant price, and then sell all of yours for that price.

The profit rate assumes chest loots per hour. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

Barrows: Rise of the Six is the "hard mode" version of the original Barrows. To access their dungeon, a Barrows totem must be acquired; players can either buy from the Grand Exchange, or loot the original Barrows chest. The totems are fairly cheap, costing  coins each; however, each totem lasts for one kill, and is not refunded upon death. Only one player needs to have totems on hand to create an instance.

To defeat the brothers, all six must be simultaneously defeated at once. Each brother has 50,000 life points. Then, upon looting the chest, the player must escape to stabilise the unstable energy; dying or lobbying will cause this energy to disappear. The majority of the profits will come from the energies themselves, although other notable drops include onyx bolts (e), inert adrenaline crystals, huge plated rune salvages and raw rocktails.

With experienced teams, it's possible to loot in excess of 35 chests an hour, as kills can be achieved within 20 seconds or less when prioritising AoE damage with damage boosts and mechanised chinchompas. The best rotation for more kills per hour is Karil on west and Ahrim on east each with any two melee brothers. Players on the east will utilise what people call the door method which will stack Ahrim and the two melee brothers so you can utilise mechanised chinchompas. Players on the west will use mechanised chinchompas whilst sometimes using a melee incite on the Karil side to kill Karil with high burst before he uses a special attack which would prolong kills. 

Magic and Melee should only be used by experienced players. Melee should not be used on a side with Ahrim there. Though the kills are incredibly fast compared to other bosses, the most time-consuming part is navigating the tunnels, as it takes 25 seconds on average for a team of four to successfully escape the tunnel, or longer if all four randomised middle segments are bridges with a poor layout. When you need to rebank, inform your team; if possible, try to arrange specific banking times, so everyone returns with full supplies.

If soloing the boss, up to 24-25 chests can be looted in an hour.

Being undead, they are affected by the salve amulet, as well as both the Undead Slayer perk and ability allows players to deal 22% additional damage for 15 seconds, or 7% when the ability is on cooldown.

The formation of the brothers change each day; refer to the table on the right for the formations.



Refer to the strategy page for more information.

The Armadyl equipment is in high demand both to use as armour, and to disassemble for Armadyl components used in Invention for the Precise perk.

Winter storage is recommended to bank the common un-noted drops such as potions. Magic notepaper can also be used. During the fight, Kree'arra will attack with both mage and range, and will use melee attacks if he gets within range. Kree'arra will use a tornado attack that pushes the player back 1 square. Thus, it it preferential to start the fight either standing in the doorway or a corner. Soul Split and the Enhanced Excalibur can be used for heals, but Kree'arra's minions also drop manta ray and mushroom potato which can be used to increase longevity.

More strategies for Kree'arra can be found on Kree'arra/Strategies.

Black salamanders are in high demand as they are often used as a disposable weapon to augment then Disassemble to train Invention.

The Boneyard Hunter area is in level 18 - 20 Wilderness - Make sure to have pvp turned off by talking to Vala in Edgeville. Most teleports will work as long as you don't go into level 21. Ring of duelling or Wilderness sword 1 or greater are recommended for quick banking, the Wilderness sword 3 can teleport anywhere under 30 wilderness so is the best choice for teleporting out. TokKul-Zo is not recommended as black salamanders will be kept over it. To reach the area, the Wilderness Crater lodestone can teleport players to south of the Wilderness Crater without cost or requirements. Carrallangar Teleport brings you closer and is faster (takes ~30 seconds to reach the area from start of teleport, versus 1 minute) but requires 84 Magic and completion of Desert Treasure and costs 2 soul runes and 2 law runes.

There is a level 44 Hill Giant in the area that is aggressive to players under level 88. Green dragons are found slightly north, but are not aggressive. Turn left click attack off in combat options to avoid accidentally attacking any of them.

Small fishing nets and ropes are cheap but might not be always available on the Grand Exchange. Nicholas Angle's Fishing Shop (northeast of Taverley lodestone) and Shantay Pass Shop (south of broomstick teleport after exiting from fountain) are convenient sources of them respectively.

Checking a net trap requires you to have 3 inventory spaces - and black salamanders cannot be dropped, only released (and they will disappear immediately). Therefore, even if you drop your small fishing nets and ropes (recommended as they are worth much less than a black salamander), you can only carry 26 salamanders in your inventory. 1 can be wielded if you have 70 Ranged. Notice that even without harralander tar (which prevents you from attacking), if you click attack on a monster, it will become aggressive.

details:
The profit rate assumes kills per hour making and noting a binding contract (gargoyle) from each kill. The Taverley shop method of selling the hellfire metal and blood of orcus to the Taverley summoning shop and rebuying to make the binding contracts is assumed to be used as it is by far the fastest method to make the not insignificant number of binding contracts needed per hour. Other methods will result in less time killing gargoyles reducing the kills per hour. Your actual profit may also be higher or lower depending on how fast you can kill gargoyles.

Killing gargoyles is highly profitable due to common salvage drops. Although gargoyles are weak to water spells, with a tier 75 Staff 100% accuracy should be possible with air spells. If you cannot maintain 100% accuracy with air switch to water spells. This raises the costs of this method by . If you use lower tier gear than robes of subjugation and use the vampyrism aura, it would be recommended taking 1 or 2 pieces of food in case you take too much damage. With subjugation or higher you should have no problems at all. If you can use Soul Split but have lower tier gear than subjugation, take 1 or 2 more prayer potions. Higher levels may utilise Aggression potion(s) or a Scrimshaw of aggression to avoid having to leave to regain aggression or click different targets continuously.

The recommended location for killing gargoyles is the Slayer Tower, north-west of Canifis, because Markus gives you Slayer contracts, which give you extra experience if you are on assignment and 20% of the normal Slayer experience if you are not on assignment. 

To get maximum kills and have an easy time gathering your drops, you have to activate area loot. Go to the top floor of the Slayer Tower and enter the southern gate to the gargoyle rooms. The southern side is better because there are more respawn locations for the gargoyles, hence faster kills. Position yourself in the middle of the southern room and start attacking the gargoyles. As soon as you have multiple items on the floor, click on a drop in the middle and, due to area loot, you only have to hit the space bar to pick everything up at once.

Sometimes (primarily caused by Asphyxiate or attacking a gargoyle behind another one) a drop lands outside the area loot range. Pick it up normally. Alternatively, if using a Legendary pet, set one of its three abilities to Scavenger and it will automatically pick up your drops for you, eliminating the risk of anything disappearing.

If not using the spring cleaner, instead intending to alch the rune and adamant salvage it is recommended to take fire runes and not a fire staff, because with runes it is possible to alch during combat. With a staff you would have to switch, leading to slower kills temporarily. As well, depending on GE values of dark mystic robe top and granite maul, it might be more lucrative to alch them or to save them using magic notepaper. 

Melee, with a halberd is a viable alternative, even preferred in some cases.

If available, the artificer's measure can be slightly more convenient being able to hold 100 of each gem as opposed to 100 total.

Access to fairy rings is strongly recommended as both the fishing spots for raw karambwanji (which are untradeable and required to catch karambwan) and raw karambwan are very close to fairy rings and otherwise remote.

Teleport to fairy ring with a karambwan vessel, which is just south of the raw karambwanji fishing spot. Do not bring a Beast of Burden as they cannot carry karambwanji. There are level 28 hobgoblins around that are aggressive to players under level 56. You may catch one or two raw shrimps along with them. Discard those. You may load a single raw karambwanji into the vessel to carry one more, but you will have to drop it first at the karambwan spot to start catching until one of them steals the bait.

Once you have a full inventory of raw karambwanji, teleport to fairy ring . Catching karambwan is almost instant but very click intensive. You must left click on the raw karambwanji, then use it on the vessel to load it, and then on the fishing spot for every catch. Additionally, when the vessel is emptied of karambwanji, it is automatically placed at the first available empty slot in your inventory, after the karambwan it just caught, which makes it move around a lot and tedious to click.

Using fairy rings and banking with TokKul-Zo and with some practice, one trip takes about 4 minutes. Some karambwan may steal your bait without being caught. The profit assumes 25 per inventory.

Using a tackle box daily can be very helpful for making more money with this method with the tele-bank option up to 500 fish per day. It also extends each bank trip with its storage.

details:
Red salamanders are in high demand as they are an inexpensive version of the dragon 2h crossbow with the same Disassemble materials yield.

This method is similar to hunting black salamanders, but safer and the Hunter level requirements are also lower. While both areas have aggressive low level monsters, red salamanders are not in the Wilderness like black salamanders are. Unlike the older method, this method does not require banking as regularly as you have the notepaper to keep you going.

Ourania Teleport teleports the user almost directly to the hunting area. Other options include Kandarin monastery teleport, spirit tree to the Battlefield, and ring of duelling to Castle Wars. Home Teleport to Yanille could be used by all members without requirements other than unlocking the lodestone.

There are level 46 Monks of Zamorak in the area that are aggressive to players under level 92. Turn left click attack off in combat options to avoid accidentally attacking any of them.

Small fishing nets and ropes are cheap but might not be always available on the Grand Exchange. Nicholas Angle's Fishing Shop (northeast of Taverley lodestone) and Shantay Pass Shop (south of broomstick teleport after exiting from fountain) are convenient sources of them respectively.

If your goal is Hunter experience this method will be more effective than the older method as using magic notepaper, although more expensive, should allow you to reach up to 400 red salamanders caught per hour, but should still make the same or more profit per hour. This method should be very effective for Hunter experience outside of the Wilderness and not a bad money making method. Great to try out if you have the Hunter level required!

The sheep pen near Taverley is the best location to collect wool due to how close it is to the bank in Burthorpe. Simply click on a sheep that has wool until your inventory is full, then bank and repeat. Each trip can be done in 100 seconds, assuming you have the pen to yourself.

The wire machine can be found in the south-west area of the city, east of a furnace. The wire respawns in 6 seconds after being taken. One trip of 28 wires takes about 5 minutes. It is possible to achieve higher profits (and additional Magic experience) by casting High Level Alchemy on a noted stack of any profitable item while waiting for the wire to spawn. Several casts can be fit into the 6-second respawn period without affecting the rate of wires stolen. Alternatively disassembling items can also be done whilst waiting.

The profit rate assumes kills per hour making a  with the scraps of scripture received from phylacteries as it is presently the more valuable of the two. If making the other khopesh, this will reduce the hourly profit by . Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed. A guide on how to kill the Magister can be found here.

The level 115 Slayer requirement is boostable; wilder pies can be used to kill the Magister if you have less than 115 Slayer.

Vital spark drop enhancers are highly recommended here as they will increase the amount of vital sparks received.

Since being made tradeable, Scentless potions have become popular among players wanting to train hunter quickly. They are also used to make Perfect juju agility potions, which are used by some players when training Agility. Unlike most potions, the scentless potion requires an untradeable secondary ingredient, and one which is considered somewhat tedious to gather at that. For these reasons, scentless potions have become significantly more valuable than their unfinished version, with a profit of at least per potion awaiting those willing to gather the shadow vines required.

Shadow vines are gathered by hunting Shadow jadinkos using a noose wand. Before hunting shadow jadinkos, they must first be attracted to the habitat. This is done by building an abandoned house and planting a red blossom seed. The former either requires level 57 Construction or costs, while the latter requires level 54 Farming (though the Assist System can be used). This only needs to be done once, unless the house and/or flower is later replaced.

While the size of the area and the large number of searchable objects might suggest that tracking jadinkos is complex, there are only a handful of paths, each requiring searching only three objects.

Starting from the east burrow, there is only one possible path. This path is relatively long and ends near the west burrow.
Starting from the west burrow, there are three possible paths to follow. Two of these are relatively long and end near the east burrow, while the last is much shorter than all the rest and ends near the west burrow.
The presence of a shorter path, and thus the shorter average path length, makes the west burrow more attractive. However, if the player is already standing much closer to the east burrow, starting there and following that path is better than running across the entire habitat to get to the west burrow.

Upon having gathered a satisfactory number of shadow vines (nine for every ten unfinished potions if using the Scroll of Cleansing, or one for each if not), the next step is to make the potions. This is done by simply adding the vines to the unfinished potions. Using the Modified botanist's mask, Portable wells, the Factory outfit, the Scroll of cleansing and Botanist's amulets to save vines or produce extra potions is highly recommended at this stage. As most of those are untradable and some have relatively high requirements, only the botanist's amulet, portable well and scroll of cleansing are included in the profit calculations.
All together, these boosts will allow you to create an average of 1.38 potions per vine, compared to just 1 potion per vine without any of them.

Since the shadow vines stack, no inventory space will be cleared while making the potions, meaning any strange or golden rocks you find will end up destroying a potion unless you are wearing the Statue collection bag.

Depending on current prices, it may be more profitable to decant all potions to 3 or 4 doses before selling. This can be done by Bob Barter (herbs) at the Grand Exchange, Rhobert Dail (herbs) at the Tower of Voices, or Rhodri Dail at the Max Guild. Currently, 4-dose potions are worth  per dose, while 3-dose potions are worth  per dose.

This guide uses a figure of  jadinkos caught and  potions made each hour. This is only an estimate, made from limited testing at level 99 hunter. Low-level players might not be able to reach these numbers, while high level players may be able to surpass them.

Ganodermic flakes are used with one piece of Mycelium poncho web to create a Ganodermic poncho. The Mycelium poncho web can be bought from the Merchant in the Polypore dungeon, near the entrance for 300 gold each, with a stock of 40.

Keep in mind that the buy limit on Ganodermic flakes is 28,000. This means that, without help from friends, you may only use this method once per four hours.

Since there is no make-x interface, using the flakes on each web poncho can be a slow and click intensive process.

Ganodermic flakes are used on one piece of Mycelium visor web to create a Ganodermic visor. The Mycelium visor web can be bought from the Merchant in the Polypore dungeon, near the entrance for 90 gold each, with a stock at 40.

Keep in mind that the buy limit on Ganodermic flakes is 28,000. This means that, without help from friends or alternate accounts, using different energy types, or buying them while doing other activities, you may only use this method once per four hours.

Since there is no make-x interface, using the flakes on each web visor can be annoying.

Ganodermic flakes are used on one piece of Mycelium leggings web to create a Ganodermic leggings. The Mycelium poncho web can be bought from the Merchant in the Polypore dungeon, near the entrance for 200 gold each, with a stock at 40.

Keep in mind that the buy limit on Ganodermic flakes is 28,000. This means that, without help from friends, you may only use this method once per four hours.

Since there is no make-x interface, using the flakes on each leggings web can be annoying.

details:
You can make money by smithing mithril bars and maple logs into mithril spears at the barbarian anvil at Gunnarsgrunn (the Barbarian Village).
It is recommended, in order to reach maximum profit, to deposit all the mithril bars into your metal bank before starting, and then set up a bank preset with 26 maple logs and your wilderness sword (with the skull sceptre equipped). Bind your scepter and your sword on your action bar. If banking using a teleport item that isn't equipped in the weapon or shield slot, 27 logs can be brought at a time instead. Memory strands are a useful option, as they can be stored in the currency pouch.

After loading your preset, teleport to Gunnarsgrunn by pressing the scepter keybind. Run to the barbarian anvil close north to where you appear, while equiping your wilderness sword, either from inventory or by pressing its keybind. Smith your 26 or 27 spears at the anvil and press the sword keybind to teleport close to the Edgeville bank. Run to the bank while equipping the scepter. Load bank preset, and repeat.

You can replace the wilderness sword with any item allowing for fast teleportation to a bank.

You should be able to smith one inventory every 11.5 minutes, making about 140 Mithril spears an hour.

The profit rate assumes catches per hour. This guide covers hunting Grenwalls at higher levels within the private hunting areas. A guide on hunting Grenwalls normally in Tirannwn can be found here. The private hunting areas are located in the Tree Gnome Stronghold, near the entrance and the Gnome Stronghold Agility Course. Using the private hunting areas requires quota tickets, which can be purchased with Competence points earned from participating in Big Chinchompa.

Grenwall spikes, worth  coins each, are used as an ingredient for extreme ranging potions. Due to their use in Herblore, they maintain high demand. When caught, Grenwalls yield bones, between 18 and 21 Grenwall spikes, and occasionally a grimy herb.

Hunter gear does not improve the chances of catching Grenwalls successfully, however standing too close to the traps may deter the Grenwall from the trap. The Tirannwn quiver 2 from the Tirannwn tasks set will remove the need for bait, effectively increasing profits and reducing the time it takes to completely set a trap. The Arctic bear familiar gives an invisible +7 boost to Hunter, and the Scentless potion renders traps set by the player as if they have been smoked. 

Using both the Tirannwn quiver 2 and the Arctic Bear familiar, it's possible to achieve over 200 catches per hour at level 85+ Hunter. With Scentless potions, the Arctic Bear familiar, and the Tirannwn quiver 2, at level 99 Hunter, it's possible to achieve 300 to 350 catches per hour.

They may also drop an assortment of grimy herbs, from ranarr to dwarf weed (excluding spirit weed, wergali, and snapdragon). It can be advantageous to bring a Bonecrusher for easy prayer experience and a herbicide for unwanted herbs.

Crafting wooden cats can be profitable due to their use in the quest The Great Brain Robbery, 10 are needed for the quest. Planks are easy to buy, while bear fur can take some time to buy from the GE.
Be aware that the wooden cats may sell slowly, so you may not be able to do this moneymaker for too many hours before the market is oversaturated with wooden cats.

Ideally your POH should be located close to a bank chest so banking can be faster and to save the cost of directly teleporting. Prifddinas portal (player-owned house) is very convenient as you can teleport with a Crystal teleport seed to Ithell and bank, then run to the portal. If you do need to teleport to your POH using an amulet of glory and wielding an elemental battlestaff means that the only runes used are law runes and glory amulets are easily recharged for free at the Heroes' Guild or The Tears of Seren in the Cadarn section of Prifddinas.

Also it is advised to relocate the workshop in your POH to the so that it's close to the portal for faster run times.

# Start at Ithell bank chest and withdrawn 14 bear fur and 14 planks
# Run to the POH house portal and run to the workshop
# Click on your crafting table and make 14 wooden cats
# Teleport back to Ithell with the crystal teleport seed and repeat

Salawa akhs are a slayer monster that can be found within the Sophanem Slayer Dungeon. This method can be used as a fully AFK money making method, however more input may be required with lower-tiered equipment. You must be using protect from melee or deflect melee from melee to survive, and a scrimshaw of vampyrism to heal.

To maximise your kills per hour, utilise this location and the amulet of zealots with Leech Strength instead of Turmoil/Malevolence and an amulet of souls. If more healing is needed, brawler's blood necklace may be used instead.

Augmented equipment with the enhanced devoted, biting, and impatient perks will often give you the ability to extend your stay. Additionally, scavenging perk will occasionally provide you with invention components, increasing the profit.

Vital spark drop enhancers are highly recommended here as they will double the amount of vital sparks received. To increase the amount of vital sparks dropped even further, the loot chest in the dungeon may be filled up with 30 different drops from the creatures in the dungeon. As long as the chest is full and vital sparks are not in it, they will drop to the ground as the salawa akhs are killed, giving them a 20% to be doubled. This will decrease the AFK time, but will noticeably increase the profits.

To make an ascension crossbow you must bring all six ascension signets, a dragon crossbow and 100 ascension shards to Ocellus. To make the Off-hand crossbow, with 100 more Ascension shards and the Ascension crossbow, use the Crossbow on Ocellus to create an Off-hand ascension crossbow. Kills per hour can be increased by attuning one of the Boss Portals (War's Retreat or Max Guild) to the Legiones, allowing you to more quickly replenish your supply of keys.

Warning: Due to the reliance of signet drops, players will be expected to lose money in the short-term much like the Magister. However, the Legiones are far more punishing with most of their drops being nowhere near the cost of their keys, and getting dry on any of the signets will greatly hamper profit rates. Therefore, be prepared to attempt this money making at your own risk.

Please note that being able to use full manual combat mode will be extremely beneficial when attempting the Legiones due to the mechanics of the bosses.

For more information on how to kill the Legiones, check the Strategy guide.

The profit rate assumes kills an hour. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your kill speed. A spear type weapon is needed at corporeal beast or you will deal 50% less damage to the boss.

To get to the boss's cave, use a games necklace or combat portal at the Max Guild or Boss portal at War's Retreat.

For maximum kills an hour, you must use both the in-world instance and as well as your own private instance so you are not waiting on respawn times for the boss. When you are experienced and comfortable with killing the boss, try using Berserk in your kills to achieve faster kills, be careful when using berserk as the corporeal beast can hit very high.

With high level melee gear (full Vestments of Havoc, Masterwork Spear of Annihilation, Enhanced Gloves of Passage), and using elder overloads, weapon poison+++ and kwuarm incense sticks, it is possible to safely afk the Corporeal Beast with melee. Penance aspect recommended, and either penance powder or switching off prayer between kills while waiting for respawn. Legendary pet (it is not a familiar so it will not be eaten) set to scavenge recommended to automatically grab drops.

details:
Ruby rings are made by combining a gold bar and a cut ruby. It is highly recommended you make a bank preset with 28 rubies.

Smith all of the bars using your 28 ore (60 if you wearing smelting gauntlets), then use the rubies preset to craft the rings. Wearing Varrock armour 2 gives a chance to smelt 2 bars at once; the medium New Varrock achievements also have to be completed for this to apply at a portable forge or Lumbridge furnace.

The process is fairly click intensive, and very tedious. The crafting can be done at the Lumbridge furnace, across the street from the Lumbridge Market bank chest. It takes 9 seconds to travel between the bank and furnace.

One cycle costs 88 seconds for 28 bars and 69 seconds for 28 rings, for a total cycle time of 157 seconds (under 3 minutes per cycle). 23 cycles per hour gives 644 rings per hour, for a profit of per hour.

The process is tedious, but requires a fairly small amount of attention. You need a furnace that is close to a bank, such as the one in Lumbridge (which is near the Lumbridge market bank) or the ones in the Artisans' Workshop. 

Each full load takes 50.4 seconds to craft, plus a few seconds for running and interface manipulation. The time taken to craft and bank is about 64 seconds for 28 necklaces. This brings the number made per hour to 1,680 (60 trips average), giving per hour.

Soft leather is used to train Crafting in free-to-play, and it is in reasonable demand. Because it must be tanned before it can be crafted, tanning cowhide into soft leather can be quite profitable at times.

It should be noted that cowhide has a buylimit of 10,000 every 4 hours so to get this hourly profit you'll have to stack up on cowhides beforehand. It is also possible to work around the limit by directly trading with other players, or by using alternate accounts. Doing this method with 10,000 cowhides will take you around 10 minutes and net you a profit of .
It's recommended to have at least coins for 5 minutes of this method requiring 5,000 cowhides, 1 portable crafter and 15,000 coins.

Because the price difference between hides and leather can be fairly small, it is important to buy the hides for a low price and sell the leather for a high price; you can lose out on up to 50% of the profit if you are not patient. Test the profit by buying one soft leather and one cowhide, making sure that the prices are good enough that you will make a decent profit. 
If you run out of cowhides, you may buy some more, but if you don't wish to spend money but you do have at least 45 Magic, you may use the Chain ability to kill more cows at once. This method makes players take less time killing cows and increases their profit per hour. Using an air mindspike or an air staff would make this process more profitable because casting air spells such as Wind Bolt or Wind Blast only requires air runes and a magic weapon.

Tanning hard leather instead is a good alternative if the price of soft leather is not high enough. While hard leather is usually more expensive (currently Hard leather  vs. Soft leather ), soft leather is often easier to sell on the Grand Exchange.

To tan soft leather with maximum efficiency, deploy a portable crafter near a bank or bank chest (for example, near the bank chest in the Lumbridge Market), make a preset with 28 cowhide, and load it. Then right-click the crafter and choose Tan Leather. Additionally, you can use portable crafters on the one already deployed to increase its duration by five minutes per crafter.

To get the fastest tanning speeds, you will need to make sure you're on the lowest ping world. 

Method: 
# Zoom in and adjust your camera so the portable crafter and the bank would be next to each other.
# Now load your bank preset by pressing a keybind, then instead of closing the bank interface, click on the portable.
# Press space, and at the same time, click on the banker.

This way you don't need to wait until the bank or tanning interface opens up and can tan with little to no delay. You should be expecting to tan 60,000 cowhides an hour however at it's peak, it is possible to tan over 6,600 cowhides per portable crafter, or nearly 80,000 per hour.

location: Any location with a bank/bank chest nearby
details:
For this method the player needs to stand close to a bank. Make a bank preset of 27 emerald amulets and 27 cosmic runes, and wield the staff of air to remove the need of any air runes. Enchant the amulets by using the Lvl-2 Enchant spell, preferably placed on an action bar for better efficiency. This action (with banking) takes around 34 seconds making it possible to enchant up to 2,858 amulets an hour.

The buy limit per 4 hours is 5,000. You will have to wait 1 hour and 45 minutes before you can buy more off the Grand Exchange. It is possible to work around the limit by letting the order fill while doing other activities, directly trading with other players, or by using alternate accounts.

See also Money making guide/Crafting emerald jewellery.

Green dragon leather is used to train Crafting, and it is always in high demand. Because green dragonhide must be tanned into leather before it can be crafted, tanning the hides in bulk can be highly profitable. It should be noted that green dragonhide has a buy limit of 10,000 hides every 4 hours. At peak efficiency, 60,000 dragonhides can be tanned in an hour, which requires stocking up beforehand but can generate a profit of coins per hour. It is also possible to work around the limit by directly trading with other players or by using alternate accounts.

Because the price difference between hides and leather can be fairly small, it is important to buy the hides for a low price and sell the leather for a high price; you can lose out on up to 50% of the profit if you are not patient. Test the profit by buying one green dragonhide and one green dragon leather. If the difference between the two is less than 200, it may be better to tan other dragonhides instead.

It should take you around 10 minutes to tan 10,000 hides. It is recommended to have at least  coins; this is the least amount of coins you need for doing this method for 5 minutes.

To tan dragon leather with maximum efficiency, deploy a portable crafter near a bank or bank chest (for example, near one of the bank chests in Fort Forinthry), make a preset with 28 green dragonhide, and load it. Then right-click the crafter and choose Tan Leather. Alternatively, you can right-click configure the portable crafter so that the default left-click action is tan hides. You can also use portable crafters on the one already deployed to increase its duration by five minutes per crafter. It is also possible to avoid the cost of the portable crafters by using those placed by other players. Fort Forinthry in World 84 almost always has a portable crafter set up next to the bank chest.

To get the fastest tanning speeds, you will need to make sure you're on the lowest ping world. 

;Method
# Zoom in and adjust your camera so the portable crafter and the bank would be next to each other.
# Load your bank preset by pressing a keybind, or by right-clicking the bank and selecting the 'Load Last Preset' option, then click on the portable.
# Press space, and at the same time, click on the banker.

This way, you do not need to wait for the bank or tanning interface to open up and can tan with little to no delay. You should expect to tan around 60,000 green dragonhides an hour. However, at its peak, it is possible to tan over 6,800 hides per portable crafter, or nearly 82,000 per hour.

Luminite can be mined in a few places, but one of the best is in the Dwarven luminite mine underneath Falador. It's recommended to have at least 15 dungeoneering as this allows you to enter the mysterious entrance close by into the Dwarven Mine resource dungeon where you will find a bank deposit box. This drastically decreases the time required to bank. Carrying an adamant ore box or better allows the player to hold more ores before needing to bank. The output is calculated having full stamina at all times. Sedimentary geodes will also be received while mining and they can later be opened to retrieve spirit shards and different gems. Wearing an amulet of glory increases the chance of receiving geodes by 1%. The player should use the best pickaxe possible as it will grant more ores per hour. Here you find a table over estimated profit per hour with different mining levels and pickaxes.

For a close approximation of ore mined per hour (of pure mining) based on your levels and gear see the mining rate calculator.

It is also possible to use the revolution or full manual combat modes which allow for up to 300 kills per hour.

Players with lower tier gear can use a hellhound and Prism of Restoration to provide more damage reduction if required. Otherwise a DPS familiar such as a ripper demon is recommended.

Nihils are highly lucrative to kill, as it drops the summoning ingredient required to make nihil familiars, which are frequently used in high-level combat.  87 summoning is required to make the pouches from the untradeable ingredients.  

To reach the location, teleport to the World Gate via the Sixth-age circuit, or teleport to the Eagles' Peak lodestone and walk south. Dial the location to Freneskae and choose "The Pit". Walk to the centre of the pit and choose spawn nihil for slayer/combat. Remember to equip the Shard of Zaros, otherwise all nihils will be aggressive upon spawning.

Smoke nihils are the easiest to kill among the 4 nihils, due to their stat draining properties being easily negated by overloads, and being relatively weak to ranged. Find a corner with high spawn rate of smoke nihils, and place corruption shot at the front of the ability bar. Bait several smoke nihils together, and walk them with fragmentation shot to increase damage taken as they move towards you. The high density of nihils means that corruption shot can take out almost half the hp of other nihils while you pick out the smoke nihils. Kill other low hp nihils when you come across them. 

Since the most valuable drop is the summoning ingredient (aviansie talons in the case of smoke nihils), prioritise picking those up and filling your beast of burden with them. Collect the elder charms as well to make the pouches. With 81 divination, you can use 10 elder energy to convert the aviansie talons to the most profitable summoning ingredient, which is usually Icyene feathers due to the popularity of the ice nihil (familiar), however it's wise to check the sale price to make sure. Blood nihil pouches can sometimes be more profitable as well. Make the pouches with 150 elder energy each, and sell on GE.  

100 kills is based on the assumption of (1) t90 ranged weapons and t70 power armour augmented with standard perks, (2) using anguish, soul split, corruption shot and walking with fragmentation shot, (3) using overloads, (4) only picking up the aviansie talons, with charming imp picking up the elder charms.

Use any anvil to forge rune bars into arrowheads. Noted rune bars can be added to the metal bank and then withdrawn, as rune arrowheads are stackable there is no need to bank. You can queue up smithing multiple sets of rune arrowheads by right clicking the anvil, choosing "open smithing interface" and selecting rune arrowheads until you have a full inventory of unfinished smithing items. You will then start to smith the arrowheads, automatically starting to smith the next unfinished item as each is completed. Maintain high heat by using a forge to progress in creating arrowheads at the fastest rate. 

Although smithing rune arrowheads only requires level 50 Smithing, level 59 Smithing is recommended in order to create each unfinished smithing item with the highest possible heat available, maximising the number of arrowheads smithed per hour.

Sacred oil is used to make pyre logs, used to cremate vyre corpses for rewards. Players are often unwilling to create it, as the process is slow and complicated. Sacred oil is made by using olive oil on the pyre at the Flamtaer temple in Mort'ton during the Shades of Mort'ton minigame. The temple needs to be repaired, and nearby shades need to be kept in check. Both of these actions generate sanctity, which is then spent to create the sacred oil and is individual to the player. Each 4-dose vial of olive oil requires 3.6 sanctity to sanctify, and no oil can be sanctified unless you have at least 10 sanctity.

On world 88, the official world for this activity, there will usually be players maintaining the temple. If this is the case, you can focus almost entirely on killing the nearby loar shades as quickly as possible. Using a halberd with multi-target abilities such as two handed Adaptive Strike and Hurricane, you can kill shades very quickly. However, using ranged or magic lets you target the shades from further away, which is useful if you have to compete with other players for kills.

Each shade has 4000 life points, and grants 2 sanctity when killed. With 100 sanctity you will be able to sanctify 26 vials of olive oil, after which you will have roughly 6 sanctity left. Thus you will have to gather sanctity twice (or even three times if using a pack yak or pack mammoth) per trip. The loar shades also have a chance of dropping useful items such as the deployable herb burner, the ectoplasmator, pieces of the ghost hunter outfit, and the cremation ability.

You may want to help repair the temple while waiting for shades to respawn, especially if there are other players killing them as well. The temple is repaired using resources. Interacting with a temple wall while having a timber beam, a limestone brick and five swamp paste in your inventory will grant you one resource. Unlike sanctity, you don't lose resources over time, so you should prepare them in advance if you think you might want to use any. Timber beams and swamp paste stack, and all the items needed for resources are sold by Razmire Keelgan in Mort'ton.

You may save some money by buying olive oil from Razmire Keelgan instead of the Grand Exchange - Razmire Keeligan stocks 500 3-dose vials at each, which are upgraded to 4-dose vials (at the same price) if you've completed the medium Morytania tasks. For comparison, the current Grand Exchange prices of 3- and 4-dose vials are  and  respectively.

Once you have a full load of sacred oil, you should head to a bank. If you have unlocked the War's Retreat teleport and have defeated the Barrows Brothers at least once, teleporting to War's Retreat, then returning via a boss portal attuned to the Barrows is by far the fastest way to bank. 

Alternatively, if you have completed Desert Treasure and have unlocked the shortcut between Canifis and Mort'ton by playing Temple Trekking, using a bank teleport to get to a bank, then returning using Kharyrll Teleport or the Canifis lodestone is also quick. 

If neither of these is an option, the bank in Burgh de Rott is the best option. This can be sped up using Drakan's medallion after The Branches of Darkmeyer.

In order to kill these efficiently players must dodge the mammoths ranged attack. When the mammoth lowers its head and grabs a rock, move two spaces while staying adjacent to the mammoth. The damage happens before the ball hits the ground, so make sure to move as soon as the mammoth lowers its trunk. Moving away will trigger a stronger special attack, so always move diagonally towards the mammoth. Occasionally it will gain a light blue bar above its head, and begin a charge attack. The recommended strategy for this attack is to tank it with the deflect melee prayer on.

A vampyrism aura is very useful.

Kal'gerion demons have a fairly generous drop table, mostly consisting of rune salvage, assorted herbs and gems. They also drop demon slayer equipment, with the gloves fetching a nice price on the Grand Exchange due to being a required item for a master treasure trail emote clue. 

They can be reached by using ring of kinship and running south-west, or by using either a Dungeoneering cape or a Hoardstalker ring to travel to the Kal'gerion resource dungeon.

The demons attack with long-range melee and use two special attacks which are very inconvenient when fighting them in the resource dungeon; a magical drag attack that heals the demon for 15% of its maximum health and stuns the player for 4 seconds, and a slam attack that deals 800-1200 damage. They also have very high Defence, with a Defence level of 90 and 40/30/50 affinity against melee, ranged and magic respectively. This makes magic the best combat style of choice, but an upgraded darklight will also suffice. Regardless, a nihil should be brought along to increase hit rate.

With Soul Split active, food will not be needed. Penance aspect helps regain prayer points. Players with 99 Slayer can choose to fight them in the Sunken Pyramid; it will be more convenient to fight multiple demons with no obstructions.

Airut are level 122 monsters that can be found west of the Phoenix lair, in Mazcab, and in Kuradal's Dungeon. They require a Slayer level of 92 to kill and are killed for their bones and the level 90 Razorback gloves.

An upgraded Bonecrusher will significantly speed up kills per hour, combining it with the Death Note relic will eliminate the need to worry about the bones, as they will be sent noted to your inventory.

When fighting airut, they begin with no stat boosts, and are in a melee stance (on two feet), or ranged stance (all four). Shortly afterwards, they will increase their defensive power, making you hit less often during the fight. Occasionally, they will beat their chests; this signals their special attack. Once they start it up, they will deal inaccurate but heavy damage up to 1300 per hit for 8-10 times. This attack can be stopped with Flurry or Rapid Fire, which will stun them and damage dealt by the player is multiplied by two, allowing for an easy kill. Stuns can stop them, but if they start it when they are stunned, it will have no effect on them.

High level players can expect over 650 kills an hour while AFK on Kuradal's Dungeon standing on the south-eastern section, without the need of a Scrimshaw of vampyrism or Vampyrism aspect with the highest level melee gear and perks.

Players are recommended to kill ripper demons in the wilderness with a Dwarven siege engine with a magic setup. See Ripper Demon/Strategies for recommended strategies.

Ripper demons are level 96 Slayer monsters that are found underneath the Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede and the deep wilderness. They use weak, but accurate melee attacks that can hit up to 1,330 damage per hit. Ripper demons can attack up to three times per auto-attack, which essentially triples their damage, although each hit is independently rolled off the player's defensive bonuses.

As the demons attack, they fill up an adrenaline bar. Once filled, the demon will jump into the air (they may either use it immediately, or wait longer), with a shadow appearing west of the player's position. If the player doesn't move away from this shadow, the demon inflicts a 32,000 hard typeless damage hit, essentially killing the player in one hit. This damage is only taken if the player is next to or underneath the shadow; simply moving one space away from the shadow is sufficient enough to avoid damage.

The demons are static upon starting combat. If the player is not next to them when they perform their next attack, they will instead teleport and apply Slaughter.

In addition to these mechanics, when the player falls below 35% health, nearby demons will become aggressive, so make sure health is kept high.

Protect/Deflect Melee should be used with Soul Split flicking, as the demons can pile a lot of damage from their attacks. A vampyrism aspect or scrimshaw also helps in recovering some health.

With Ancient Summoning you can bind ripper demons with Binding contracts. The demon is bound into the contract, allowing players to use Ripper Demons as offensive familiars. They are stronger than steel titans, and fetch a hefty price on the Grand Exchange due to this. Note that magic notepaper must be brought along, as a binding contract is made after each demon is killed, and they will not be made if the player's inventory is full.

If players are intending to make binding contracts, players should instead opt for an attuned ectoplasmator with a demon horn necklace instead, to conserve inventory space, despite losing some profit from the cost of ghostly essence. They may also use infernal urns.

Players may also utilise the Death Note relic power to note the infernal ashes for additional profit.

Upon entry to the skeletal wyverns' cave in Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, the player is somewhat cold and the base poison damage from wyverns is 300. This means the player is in the "Cold" (around 20-25%) mechanic and should light one of the static fires nearby. As the player gets colder, an icy overlay becomes more visible on their screen. Several mechanics will take place depending on the chill from the cavern:

* Warm: Wyvern poison damage increased up to 900 per 4-5 ticks.
* Cold (25%): Wyvern attack damage greatly increases to around 2,500.
* Coldest (90%): Player will be constantly stunned at 8–10 seconds per stun; if fighting the wyverns in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon, it is highly advised to use Freedom and get out of the cavern if this happens.

The warmer the player is, the higher the poison damage they will take, starting at about 600 damage, every 4-5 ticks, at 0% chill. As the player gets colder, the poison damage will start getting weaker, at about 70% chill, where the poison damage completely stops. A downside to this is that the Wyverns' basic attacks will get stronger the colder the player is, this can be countered by standing in melee range, as they will only attack with melee, and using Protect/Deflect Melee, along with Devotion, or repeatedly stunning the wyvern, preventing it from attacking.

Players are recommended to keep chill between 65% and 85%, where the poison is negated, and wyverns attacks can be blocked. Standing next to a lit fire will slowly warm a player. Lit fires will only last a short time before they must be lit again. The chill effects can be reset by leaving the cavern.

Wyverns hit incredibly hard with all 3 combat styles, as well as poisoning and using dragon fire. It is not worth attempting to kill them without wyrmfire potion and antipoison++. If you stand in melee distance, the wyverns will only attack using melee, so it is recommended to use short range melee weapons, pray Deflect Melee and to barge between kills. Melee will also allow a scrimshaw of vampyrism, which will help heal during kills. Abilities that cause a stun are also recommended as it will reduce the damage dealt by the wyverns.

They can be poisoned, so cinderbane gloves are recommended, together with weapon poison +++ and kwuarm incense sticks. An upgraded bonecrusher will help pick up the bone drops. Instead of picking up the bones, it is also possible to wear the demonhorn necklace which, together with the (toolbelted) bonecrusher will negate the need for any sort of prayer restoration (no need for penance powder, penance aspect, prayer-restoring potions or ancient elven ritual shard)

This attack is signified when purple rings surround the vinecrawler, which it expels towards the player's position in a manner similar to arhats. Use of Protect from/Deflect Magic alongside Devotion, an Enhanced Excalibur, Vampyrism aspect, and occasional uses of Resonance with a shield switch (after taking off Protect from Magic) can lead to needing very little food, and may allow you to stay for much longer periods than without using the resonance-shieldbow switch to heal.

It will then release a poison cloud dealing up to 3,000 damage in the nearby area and healing itself for 2,000 lp in the process. This attack can be avoided by running 5 squares away (Surge or Escape) or forcing the crawler to move by standing under it. The attack can also be blocked and healed in full from a well-timed Resonance.

The profit rate assumes kills per hour with high input using Revolution, detonate, and Animate Dead. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed. With Greater Chain unlocked followed by use of Tuska's Wrath, Detonate, and other thresholds, over 750 kph can be obtained. 

Moss golems exclusively use melee attacks, with a halberd-type range attack, and deal extremely high damage. During the fight, if the moss golem takes too long to kill, it will say *glug glug*, throwing its head into a random spot near it. Audible popping sounds will be heard when it does this. If it is still not killed, the head will turn into a level 91 mossy rock that will assist the golem in dealing damage. This can be avoided by standing on top of the tile that the head appears on. Killing the moss golem will also kill all mossy rocks it summoned.

Stand near the north-west hill and place your oldak coil down. You will want to be in a spot, hugging the hill, so that fewer moss golems can surround the player. Pray protect/deflect melee, item protect, and turmoil. The coil will pull the moss golems in, use AoE abilities to kill them with area loot toggled so you do not have to move far from your spot.

While rune dart tips can be smithed by a current free player, they must have previously completed The Tourist Trap, a members-only quest.

Use any anvil to forge rune bars into dart tips. Noted rune bars can be added to the metal bank and then withdrawn, as rune dart tips are stackable there is no need to bank. You can queue up smithing multiple sets of rune dart tips by right clicking the anvil, choosing "open smithing interface" and selecting rune dart tips until you have a full inventory of unfinished smithing items. You will then start to smith the dart tips, automatically starting to smith the next unfinished item as each is completed. Maintain high heat by using a forge to progress in creating nails at the fastest rate. 

Although smithing rune dart tips only requires level 50 Smithing, level 59 Smithing is recommended in order to create each unfinished smithing item with the highest possible heat available, maximising the number of dart tips smithed per hour.

Portents of restoration X are portents which restore the life points of the player carrying them when they fall below 50%. As a way to restore life points in an emergency with no input required and no loss of adrenaline, they are quite attractive to players engaging in risky combat encounters. This means creating them can be rather profitable, for those who have the Divination level to do so.

Each portent of restoration X is made from a rocktail and 60 incandescent energy, and can be made anywhere. Up to 27 portents can be made per inventory, from 27 rocktails and 1620 energy. Using bank presets to speed up the banking process is recommended. Even higher rates can be achieved by two-ticking the creation of the portents.

details:
With smelting gauntlets, you can smelt 60 bars at a time (60 bars/batch) instead of 28.

Smelting Speed

At level 94+, it should take around 72 seconds to make an inventory of Elder rune bars when used with Superheat form, deposit them into your metal bank and then start the process over again. 

* 2 ticks/base bar (3,000 base bars/hour) - (Smithing Level 94+ w/ Superheat Form). (72 seconds/batch).
* 3 ticks/base bar (2,000 base bars/hour) - (Smithing Level 94+) - (108 seconds/batch, multiply output by 3/4.)
* 4 ticks/base bar (1,500 base bars/hour) - (Smithing Level 91-93) - (144 seconds/batch, multiply output by 1/2).
* 5 ticks/base bar (1,200 base bars/hour) - (Smithing Level 90) - (180 seconds/batch multiply outputby 2/5).

Bonus Bars (% Chance to produce Double Bars)

13.33% is the maximum chance of smelting an extra bar (a bonus bar) each time you smelt a bar (a base bar), without using any additional resources (the max double bar chance).

So you can smelt up to 3,000 base bars an hour; and with the 13.33% chance of doubling the bar while smelting you get, on average, an additional bonus bars per hour. 
This makes it possible to smelt a total of  bars per hour.

The maximum double bar chance is derived from combining the following buffs:
* At Smithing level 92, you have a 10% chance of smelting an extra bar without using any additional resources.  ( bonus bars per hour).
* Wearing Varrock armour 4+ grants an additional 1% chance of smelting an extra bar without using any additional resources. Obtaining Varrock armour 4 requires completing the elite Varrock achievements.  Completing the easy New Varrock achievements provides this bonus even when you aren't wearing your Varrock Armour. ( bonus bars per hour).
* Completing the hard New Varrock achievements doubles the effect of the Varrock Armour 4--granting an additional 1% chance of smelting an extra bar without using any additional resources.  ( bonus bars per hour).
* Wearing the Modified blacksmith's helmet grants an additional 1% chance of smelting double bars without using any additional resources.  ( bonus bars per hour).
* The augmented crystal hammer (at item level 20) with Fortune 3  --  Using a Hammer-tron, Enhanced Hammer-tron, or Crystal Hammmer that has been Augmented with the Fortune perk grants an additional 0.1%/0.2%/0.3% chance of smelting double bars (at Fortune 1/2/3 respectively). This is increased to 0.11%/0.22%/0.33% if the augmented tool is level 20.  ( bonus bars per hour).

General Tips

Smithing provides a way to get clues (via the Prosper perk on your augmented tool), at a rate of 1/960 clues per bar smelted. Having your augmented crystal hammer levelled up to level 20 raises the clue chance to 1/864 clues per bar smelted.

It's highly recommended that the player has at least level 94 Smithing to use this method since at level 92, you have a 10% chance of doubling a bar while smelting, and at level 94, you smelt elder rune bars faster. 
It's also highly recommended to use the Superheat Form prayer while smelting as this allows you to smelt bars 0.6 seconds faster.

If an Orthen furnace core is used, Superheat Form can be used for NO prayer point cost, increasing profit and ability to AFK. Without it, 12 doses of Super prayer renewal potion are needed an hour, adding an extra cost of . A grace of the elves is optional, but it halves the prayer point drain of Superheat Form, meaning you'll drink fewer super prayer renewal doses. An ancient elven ritual shard can also reduce this cost to 0 when paired with the prayer cost reduction from the grace of the elves.

Six level 18 spellwisps are found north-west of Wizard's Tower. While they are weak to Ranged, other combat skills could also kill them with ease due to their low health. They drop various items such as impious ashes (which is a 100% drop), water talismans, and a variety of runes.

In order to obtain a rate of around 500 kills per hour, it's recommended to kill the wisps quickly in a clock-wise or counter clock-wise fashion. When you finish killing one wave, you have around 30 seconds to loot the items with Area loot and prepare for the next wave by the next spawn location. Once your inventory is almost full (less than 10 spaces left) you should kill one wave and then, instead of looting the items, deposit your current items by right clicking and choosing 'Deposit Items' on Wizard Myrtle who is stood on the west side of the entrance to the Wizard Tower near the arches. It is possible to accomplish even more than 500 kills per hour by using strategies such as World hopping. 

For lower levelled players, you can use the Legacy Combat Mode in order to kill the spellwisps faster, possibly even one-hitting them. This, however, prevents you from using useful movement abilities such as Surge.

This boss fight consists of only phase 2 of the fight done during Hero's Welcome against the abomination. The boss's health will immediately be reduced to 66,000 as the fight begins. 
The Ragged Abomination possesses five attacks:

#A basic melee attack that has a high accuracy that scales to a player's equipment
#A charge attack used when the player moves too far away from the Abomination that stuns the player and then performs two melee attacks
#A fireball that can be released with its melee attack that follows the player and deals 5% of their maximum health in damage upon impact. The surrounding squares will be set alight and burn the player for 3.33% of their maximum health per tick; dragonfire protection has no effect whatsoever on this attack
#A slam attack that stuns the player and deals damage equal to 1/8 of their maximum health; an onscreen warning message will show
#Rocks falling from the ceiling that deal 3.33% of the player's maximum health in damage. The falling rocks can land anywhere, including any safespots the player may use.

As its attacks are scaled to player's equipment, power armour should be used instead of tank armour as they would provide the same defensive properties; Protect from Melee or Deflect Melee will still halve the damage output, however. Experienced players will find that Soul Split can be used to leech back health they may have lost during the fight. The falling rocks and fire mechanics can be used to the player's advantage as the Ragged Abomination can also take damage from these attacks while in the area of effect, dealing even more damage to its already low health; these cannot deal the final blow to the boss. 

Unless using Animate Dead with magic tank armour, the fight involves moving around in order to avoid the AoE damage from fire and falling rock as well as the slam, so players may find it easier to manage if they use Ranged or Magic. Melee can be a viable option if a player uses a halberd-style weapon, and/or has the ability to use Bladed Dive.

This guide assumes that the player gets 35 kills a hour, or about a kill every 2 minutes. However, due to its low health, players with tier 90 equipment will find that they can get kills in 30 seconds to 1 minute, effectively doubling the profit shown.

details:
This guide uses an estimate of kills per hour. It's possible to exceed these numbers with good equipment, but this number falls drastically as equipment worsens. While tier 90+ weaponry, attuned crystal armour, Malevolence and Greater Fury are not all required, players missing several of them may find themselves unable to safely fight more than three or four shapeshifters at once, which significantly reduces kill speeds and thus revenue.

Crystal shapeshifters drop significant amounts of rune salvage and their guaranteed drop of Tarddian crystals are also worth a decent bit of money, and under the right circumstances they can be killed very quickly.

When placed in the rooms in the Sunken Pyramid, crystal shapeshifters will always spawn in their melee form. They can change form, but they will usually only change to the form you are the weakest to, unless you're using protection prayers to defend against that style. By wearing crystal armour, which is hybrid armour (as well as providing some useful effects when fighting the shapeshifters) along with a single piece of mid-level ranged equipment you can ensure they will not change from their melee form without penalising your accuracy too much and allowing access to invention perks such as Scavenging, Biting, or Crackling. This not only means they will walk up to you so you can reach them without having to move, but also makes them use their special attack less frequently, reducing the damage taken and the risk of dying. Depending on the equipment used in other equipment slots, you may need to use higher tier ranged armour to make sure your melee defence is your lowest defence.

The crystal armour also provides a boost to damage dealt to the shapeshifters, increases the number of tarddian crystals dropped, and if at least four pieces are worn provides a chance of temporarily becoming immune to stuns, as well as clearing damage over time effects inflicted by the shapeshifters.

As the shapeshifters should be kept in their melee form at all times, and as Deflect Melee would cause them to change to a different form, and because shapeshifters consistently disable protection prayers, Soul Split is the only overhead prayer that should be used.

You may want to bring some food and a prayer potion in case of emergency, although they should usually be unnecessary. Players who struggle to keep themselves alive without it may want to bring the enhanced excalibur.

A good revolution bar for multitarget damage and healing can be found here and looks as follows:

* Omit Chaos Roar if not owned.
* Replace Greater Fury with Fury if the greater version is not yet unlocked.

It is possible that you end up dying if you get repeatedly stunned at bad times, although this is relatively rare, and the reclaim costs are relatively low thanks to the low value of crystal armour.

Use area loot to easily pick up all drops. To avoid missing items that de-spawn, you will want to do this at least every 90 seconds.

Aggression potions are not required, as shapeshifters will remain aggressive indefinitely. Aggression must be toggled on by talking to Angof - this applies both to the sunken pyramid and to Tarddiad. In a small room, it is possible to have all five shapeshifters attack from their spawn points while you stand in a corner, thus maximizing the targets that Adaptive Strike will hit with its Aoe cone effect. In a large room, this is not possible due to the aggression range. You may find that, in order to aggro all of the shapeshifters, at least one of them will attack from a third direction, reducing the effect. For this reason, fighting shapeshifters in a small room is advised.

A strategy guide for crystal shapeshifters can be found here.

other: Higher Hunting Level to set more traps at once
details:
Orange salamanders are in high demand as they are valuable source of Invention components through disassembly.

Utilizing Sign of the porters or Grace of the Elves as alternative methods to Magic Notepaper reduces input cost, and recommended if players have access through the Divination skill.

Al Kharid Lodestone is not bad for people who want a free teleport out to this hunting location, though it can be quite a run, a Dominion medallion is a much closer teleport. This method is similar to hunting red salamanders. While the profit is lower, the experience may be slightly higher because orange salamanders are faster to catch. The Hunter level requirements are also lower. Unlike the older method, this method does not require banking as regularly as you have Magic notepaper to keep you going.

Small fishing nets and ropes are cheap but might not be always available on the Grand Exchange. Nicholas Angle's Fishing Shop (northeast of Taverley lodestone) and Shantay Pass Shop (south of broomstick teleport after exiting from fountain) are convenient sources of them respectively.

If your goal is Hunter experience this method will be more effective than the older method as using magic notepaper, although more expensive, should allow you to reach up to 400 or so orange salamanders caught per hour, but should still make the same or more profit per hour. This method should be very effective for Hunter experience outside of the Wilderness and not a bad money making method.

Teleport to the Fremennik lodestone and go north and slightly east, through a few aggressive Rock Crabs and a narrow snowy path to arrive at the Rellekka Hunter area to hunt sabre-toothed kebbits. Their teeth can be ground into dust used in Herblore for making Hunter potions. Cut dead trees in the area for logs to set the trap.

This article assumes one trip in 12 minutes (for 28 kebbit teeth each trip; without using a Beast of Burden) or five trips per hour.

As only one deadfall trap can be set at a time, most of the time is spent waiting for a trap to be triggered. Hunting other creatures in the same area (particularly Snowy knight and Sapphire glacialis for high-level players) can greatly increase experience gain.
Kebbit teeth dust is worth more than kebbit teeth alone - assume grinding before selling.

This article assumes the Lodestone Network is used to teleport to the Taverley lodestone and enter the player-owned house there (House Teleport can be used with 40 Magic, it is faster but consume runes), and a Beast of Burden is not used. Banking can be done via various teleportation methods (e.g. ring of duelling, or a mounted amulet of glory in the Quest Hall requiring 47 Construction). Each trip can be done within 2 minutes (30 trips an hour assumed).

Alternatively, if you have access to the Ithell district and an attuned crystal teleport seed, you can teleport to the Ithell district bank chest directly and then move east to the nearby POH portal.

This method assumes an elemental battlestaff is equipped, and a banking preset with 1 law rune and 27 steel bars is key-binded.

# Grab all required materials in the bank.
# Use the spell House Teleport (no rune cost with 50 Construction, or if using the Abyssal Link relic).
# Use the clockmaker's bench (clockmaker's bench 2 or higher) within the workshop to make 27 clockworks.
# Use Clan vexillum or Ring of Fortune (or other luck rings) to Grand Exchange to access the bank. Alternatively:
#* Use War's Retreat Teleport.
#* Use TokKul-Zo to TzHaar Fight Cave or Fight Kiln.
#* Use Skull of Remembrance.
#* Use Wilderness sword 1 to Edgeville bank.
#* Use mounted amulet of glory in the Quest Hall (requiring 47 Construction) to Draynor bank.
#* Use attuned crystal teleport seed to the Ithell district. You can then move east to the nearby player-owned house portal.
# Grab preset, and repeat.

Each trip can be done in 1 minute and 30 seconds, 40 trips an hour assumed.

For this method the player needs to stand close to a bank. Make a preset of 14 Ruby amulets (unstrung) and 14 ball of wool. To string the amulets simply left click a ball of wool and then left click a ruby amulet (unstrung), the interface will open up and you'll just have to press "spacebar" to begin the action. activity: Running the Anachronia Agility Course for codex pages
output1note: Can only be converted from the codex pages received in increments of 750. This means it will generally take around 9 hours to obtain any money from this method.
details:
The profit assumes an average of 2 extra codex pages per lap and running 9 laps an hour using 2 doses of powerburst of acceleration per lap.

Each lap at the Anachronia Agility Course gives a guaranteed 10 codex pages. An additional 1-3 codex pages can be randomly received when completing any obstacle. By having at least tier three luck (such as a ring of fortune or a charged collector's insignia), players can improve their chances of gaining additional codex pages when completing obstacles. With tier 3 luck, each lap will grant a total of 12 codex pages on average.

The course is spread out with open areas between obstacles. Using Bladed Dive or Dive and Surge, along with the Mobile perk will allow for faster laps (up to an additional lap per hour). Powerbursts of acceleration can also be used to quickly surge and dive on parts of the course, further saving time. With double surge, dive, mobile, and an optimised route, players can expect lap times of around 6 minutes, allowing for 9 to 10 laps per hour. Double surge is highly recommended; without it, each lap will take 6:30 to 7 minutes or even longer, which hurts the profit rate significantly.

At level, one bite of summer pie can be used per lap if used at the first level 85 obstacle ( coins per lap). Once per day, a god banner can also be used to boost the player's Agility level by 5 for 30 minutes (roughly 4 laps). At level , one dose of agility potion can be used per lap if used at the first level 85 obstacle ( coins per lap).

When used to create a tradeable Double Surge codex, each page is worth coins. When used to create a tradeable Double Escape codex, each page is worth  coins.

input5note: Gear repair
details:
The profit rate assumes kills per hour, but it's possible to get up to 1,200 kills per hour. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

Members of the Order of Ascension are killed for their ascension keystone drops. Capsarii are preferable to Rorarii due to their lower health, allowing for more kills per hour. Death is also extremely unlikely compared to Rorarii given their extremely low damage.

Unfortunately, compared to the other two members, Capsarii are spread fairly far apart across the dungeon. At most, there are only two areas with three spawns of Capsarii: the chamber south of Legio Primus' laboratory, and the area north of the ascended Guthix, both of which are surrounded by other members, which would make this money making method unviable.

For this reason, Capsarii souls are placed in the Sunken Pyramid for farming purposes; any room works, but the small room is the most optimal for collecting drops. The Sunken Pyramid allows the player to camp Capsarii without any competition, and provides access to five spawns. In order to access the Sunken Pyramid, the player must have 99 Slayer. If the player does not have the five Capsarii souls needed, then they can use another player's dungeon which has them as long as that person's private settings allow them to enter and both players are on the same world. However, as other players may also be using the dungeon, it's generally better to get the Capsarii souls yourself. The most ideal location to farm them is to continually sweep the south-western area of the Monastery, which contains seven fairly spaced Capsarii spawns but should be enough for any player to loop through them without world hopping.

When the Capsarii souls are collected (or if the player is using another player's dungeon), farming Capsarii is extremely simple. It is highly recommended to go into Legacy Mode while using a bow with no ammunition - such as a Zaryte bow, Decimation or Seren godbow and drink an aggression potion of any type. Legacy Mode increases the strength of your auto-attacks, and Capsarii will often die in a single hit to these weapons. Though a hexhunter bow provides a damage bonus against Capsarii, it is ill-advised due to its somewhat low damage output in Legacy Mode along with the cost of arrows. Using EoC mode allows for any ranged weapon to be used, but forces the player to pay more attention. 

Augmented gear can be used with Precise 6, Eruptive 4 and Ruthless 3 will ensure 1-hitting Capsarii most of the time. Damage-increasing armour perks generally do not increase the kill rate with higher-levelled weapons, but Scavenging can be used to collect components, Enhanced efficient can be used to lower charge drain rate, or Efficient can be used to increase XP Capacitor 5000 level rate. 

A steel titan is recommended to speed up kills in the event that an attack does not kill a Capsarii in a single hit; scrolls are optional. The steel titan takes higher priority over other ranged familiars, as it possesses a Ranged level of 90, and any other familiar such as a shadow nihil can miss their hit. Make sure the titan is far from Capsarii so that it does not use its melee attack; recall the titan if necessary to move it out of melee range. The titan should also focus on capsarii with low health so a player auto-attack is not wasted on them. Note that the titan may focus on another target when attempting to change its target acquisition.

Players can easily keep their health high with the Vampyrism aspect. To save on rune costs, the blood amulet of fury also helps in keeping the player's health high. An enhanced Excalibur can also be brought along for additional healing if the blood amulet is unable to keep the player's health high. Soul Split should be used if neither of these two options work, and simply flicking it ensures very little prayer points are used. If not using overloads, then standard range potions should be supplemented with the Berserker curse to slightly prolong its duration. 

As little to no prayer is used, an ancient elven ritual shard may be brought along to restore any depleted prayer points. 

Expected pure essence per hour.jpg
Capsarii frequently drop various elemental battlestaves, medium adamant plated salvage and tiny spiky rune salvages, which often account for roughly 25-33% of the profit made. If a spring cleaner is taken, ensure it alchemises the aforementioned salvages, and toggle battlestaves off, as the alchemy value of the elemental battlestaff is 9,300 coins, while disassembly to base components will reduce the value of the battlestaff by almost 55%, as the spring cleaner will convert the resulting elemental orb into the respective elemental runes, cosmic runes and an unpowered orb, which yields very little money. A gold accumulator can also be taken to auto-collect coin drops, but is not mandatory. The remaining profit comes from the keystone drops. Pure essence, coal stone spirits, yew logs and unpowered orbs can be picked up but is generally not recommended as it slows kill rates.
