details:
The profit rate assumes kills per hour, based on Morvran assigning a median of 170-265. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

Ranged is arguably more efficient than melee at edimmu due to the 100% hitchance on elite edimmu; however, melee is much easier due to being able to use the scrimshaw of vampyrism to assist with healing.

Activate Protect from Magic/Deflect Magic and Anguish. Place your cannon two tiles directly north of the southern pillar. All abilities are AOE using mechanised chinchompas, so just use a normal DPS rotation, prioritise Devotion so as to significantly reduce incoming damage when edimmu are grouped up. 

In order to group up the edimmu, the cannon will tag them making them walk towards you, by going out of the barrier they are forced to walk into the entrance way. You cannot stay outside the barrier for too long, as edimmu have a very short aggression period if they cannot attack you, and after 6 seconds they will walk away until either you or your cannon tags them again. The aggression ability can be used to speed up kills by grouping more easily. You will run to the far end of the arena, activate aggression, then run back to the barrier.

details:
This guide assumes you successfully loot tombs in an hour. Your profit rate may be higher or lower depending on speed.

Shifting Tombs is an activity that can be used to stockpile Feathers of Ma'at which are used to kill corrupted creatures and soul devourers. It is also the only source to obtain the off-hand khopesh of the Kharidian, a tier 82 off-hand stabbing weapon which may be upgraded with drops from The Magister to turn it into the tier 92 Khopesh of Elidinis.

Before starting Shifting Tombs, disable all experience rewards and only select the coins option. This will ensure that when you leave the tomb, you will be given a hefty sum of coins instead of experience in various skills. It's also recommended to have level 90 in the skills required so the highest tier can be accessed.

Shifting Tombs has three major requirements in order to obtain maximum reward potential: looting sarcophagi, treasure chests, and removing corruption from the tomb within 5 minutes. 

Sarcophagi can be found at the fringes of the tomb, or generally slightly off a branching path. In order to be opened and looted the player needs to follow the sequence the sarcophagus releases onto one of the six Desert Pantheon deities. Sarcophagi do not guarantee loot, but there is a 1/200 chance to loot a soul talisman. There is also a rare chance of looting a small gift offering from the sarcophagi, which can turn into a medium sized offering with tier 3 or higher luck. As sarcophagi do not guarantee loot, and the rare drops of the gift offerings being extremely rare, it's generally only recommended to loot the required amount of sarcophagi.

Treasure chests commonly contain 5–18 feathers of Ma'at, but if all experience has been toggled off then the chest will contain 10–36 instead. The feathers make up roughly 25–30% of the profit. There is also a 1/800 chance to loot an off-hand khopesh of the Kharidian, worth . Chests should always be looted because of the potential of obtaining the khopesh, along with feathers generating a considerable amount of money. If a tomb does not have chests, players should quickly exit and start over to save time. Occasionally, corrupted scarabs may appear after opening a treasure chest. These should be ignored if making money is your goal.

Corruption in the tomb comes in the form of crystallised corruption or being held in various containers. Corruption should never be mined unless absolutely necessary as it yields no rewards and fill the bar slowly. Containers, on the other hand, can fill the corruption task fairly quickly and yield a varying amount of coins upon being broken. These coins make up roughly 10–15% of the profit made.

Inside the tomb, players can use Surge, Double Surge, and Dive/Bladed Dive to quickly navigate the corridors while running. Some weight-reducing clothing is optional but not required with high Agility levels. If run energy becomes depleted, you can take a small rest in the tomb if you have the time - otherwise, rest outside once the run has been completed.

When all objectives are completed in the tomb, immediately find the exit rope and leave. You will be awarded a good amount of coins at the end of each run, as the statues' experience option should have been disabled. The coins made up from clearing a tomb generate roughly 55–60% of the profit made. As with looting sarcophagi, there is also a chance to obtain small (and medium with tier 3 or higher luck) gift offerings upon clearing.

An inventory of 28 Yew Logs can be crafted into 14 Yew incense sticks. This can be done at any bank. Setting a bank preset to be 28 Yew logs can make the banking process slightly easier. Players can simply buy yew logs at the Grand Exchange, process and resell the sticks. It takes 42 seconds to process 28 yew logs, so a full load of 2000 will take at least 3024 seconds, or 50 minutes.

The profit shown assumes that you can kill rabbits per hour, actual profits depend on your killing speed.

Two colonies of 7 rabbits can be found in Burthorpe, one south of the bank and one to the east. They respawn roughly 2 seconds after being killed, making them very suitable for obtaining raw rabbits. It is recommended to bind all of the following to the action bar for efficiency: the weapons staff of air, chargebow, the magic abilities Chain and Dragon Breath, the ranged abilities Ricochet and Bombardment. Setting up a keybind for cycling target (found in settings under Gameplay->Combat->Targeting->Target Cycling Keybinds), is also recommended. Area loot should be used for picking up drops.

Start by killing the rabbits, alternating between the ranged and magic abilities mentioned above. There should be enough drops for a full inventory of 28 after 35 to 40 seconds. Pick up the drops and store them at the bank to the north. Experiment with the time spent on killing rabbits to find the best rate of profit for your situation, keeping in mind that drops disappear after 2 minutes.

As the rabbits only have 5 life points, they are very easy to kill even with 1 in combat skills, even though it may not be quite as fast without multi-hitting abilities.

Torstol incense sticks are used by wealthy players for their global experience boost. While it would technically be faster to use infernal magic incense sticks in the process, there is no profit margin for whoever makes those, and as such they will hardly ever be found on the Grand Exchange. It takes 5 ticks to apply the ashes to the sticks, then 6 ticks to apply the herb to the ashed sticks. Accounting for some extra time for banking, 500 ashed and herbed incense sticks per hour is a reasonable expectation.

The Prayer experience from ashing the magic incense sticks is identical to the experience from scattering the infernal ashes, but unlike typical Prayer and Firemaking training methods, incense turns the logs and ashes into a sellable product rather than simply being destroyed, making it a rare method of training either skill that can actually make money in the process. It is slower Prayer XP than scattering the ashes due to the time required per ash and about half the time being taken up with applying the herb instead, to say nothing of using altars for Prayer training, but it is Prayer XP at a profit nonetheless.

Other incense types may be profitable, but Torstol and Fellstalk generate the most Prayer XP, and incenses below Cadantine generate significantly less due to using Impious or Accursed rather than Infernal, which grant much less Prayer XP each.

activity: Making Smoke Devil scroll (Dust Cloud)s during the the Amlodd Voice of Seren
details:
The Smoke devil's special move, Dust Cloud, deals up to at least 791 magic damage to 6 nearby enemies, which is very useful for killing low level monsters with dense spawns like Turoths and Corpse spiders. Because most players choose to buy these scrolls on the Grand Exchange instead of making them, there is lots of profit in turning Smoke devil pouches into scrolls.

To start off, buy smoke devil pouches on the Grand Exchange. They have a buying limit of 5,000 per four hours. To save money, find the lowest price that others are buying the pouches for, and put in an offer slightly higher than theirs. This can be achieved by instantly buying a pouch at a high price, and then selling it for a low price. Buy pouches for slightly more than yours sold for, over-cutting other buyers. It will take longer to fulfil, but it will greatly increase the profit.

The best way to make scrolls is at the Amlodd obelisk during the Amlodd Voice of Seren. Begin by summoning a Beast of Burden, and withdrawing 28 smoke devil pouches into both your inventory and your familiar. Use the attuned crystal teleport seed to teleport to the Amlodd district, and run to the Obelisk. Use your pouches on the obelisk, and they will be made into scrolls. Withdraw from your familiar, and use your pouches on the obelisk again. Teleport to a bank by using the attuned crystal teleport seed to travel to Ithell (8) or Trahaearn (0). Bank your scrolls and repeat. Each run takes 30 seconds, so you can use around 7200 pouches per hour using a pack mammoth. This produces around 86,400 scrolls per hour.

You can decrease the travel time and increase the overall profit per hour by keybinding your Attuned crystal teleport seed as well as using the Surge ability with the Mobile perk.

After you've made all of your scrolls, sell them on the Grand Exchange. 
The efficiency of this method may depend on current market trends, so it would be wise to to try to maximise your profit by buying one of the scrolls instantly, and selling yours for slightly less than that.

As of the time of writing, it is common for the Grand Exchange price of the Smoke devil pouches to be considerably lower than actual buying price, so be aware that it is unlikely you will see the kind of profits quoted above.

To make a spear of Annihilation, a spear of Annihilation tip has to be obtained first. Spear of Annihilation tips can be obtained by excavating the Bandos's sanctum debris excavation hotspot in the Warforge Dig Site.

The spear of Annihilation tip has a 1/50000 chance to be obtained upon successfully excavating a material. Thus, increasing the chance to receive materials should be prioritised to obtain higher profit rates. The following have an impact on the chance to receive materials:
* Focus - Higher level mattocks provide a higher focus. The guildmaster Tony's mattock has the highest focus, but due to its price, a mattock of Time and Space would likely be the best option.
* Master archaeologist's outfit - Provides a 7% increase to materials received.
* Balarak's sash brush - Provides a 10% increase to materials received.
* Honed - Each rank of honed provides a 2% increase to materials received. 
* Material manual - Provides a 10% increase to materials received. The cost of a manual may be higher than the expected increase in profit, therefore, only use material manuals if the output above is higher than.

Always make sure to check prices before you invest heavily into the method.

Cut the Elder logs into Elder arrow shafts, then combine them with Feathers to create Elder headless arrows.

Using a Fletching cape provides a 0.75% chance to make extra arrows. Using a Portable fletcher provides a 10% chance to save arrowheads and headless arrows when making arrows. A tier 2 Ranger's Workroom has a 1% chance to fletch an extra bundle of these arrow shafts and headless arrows. Crystal knife provides a 5% double these arrow shafts.

Due to the buy limit of Feathers being 100,000 (compared to the buy limit of Elder logs being 25,000), it is suggested to put in a large order of Feathers so they buy slowly while you cut the Elder logs into Elder arrow shafts. Be warned that prices can fluctuate over a long period of time, so profitability may increase or decrease depending on the costs.

There are 7 Adolescent White wolves scattered along the eastern ridge of the White Wolf Mountain in the f2p area, just north of the Taverley bank. Starting by killing the southernmost one and going north until you've killed all 7 and picked up their drops, then go back to the southern end when the first would be about to respawn. Killing all of them twice fills the inventory, then use the Lodestone Network to teleport to Taverley and bank.

However, because of the relatively slow respawn and the time needed to run back to start again, it is faster to world hop. Starting from the south, kill all 7, stay at the north end, switch to another world, then kill all 7 again from north to south, which conveniently lets you go to the bank. This can be up to 25% faster overall (depends on how fast you switch worlds) and the maximum profit per hour is based on this method.

Avoid going further north than necessary, as several aggressive level 42 wolves are found there and could be dangerous to low level players.

Teleport to the Anachronia lodestone and head to the pavosaurus rex location, just south of the feral dinosaurs. You can use Anticipation or Freedom to avoid pavosaurus rex's stuns. Set up your traps, checking and relaying them as grenwalls are caught. With completion of the Medium Tirannwn achievements bait is not required to trap grenwalls. Level 80 Hunter is recommended as it allows five box traps to be placed at the same time. The arctic bear familiar gives an invisible +7 boost to Hunter and scentless flasks give a slight improvement to catch rate. 

This guide is based on grenwall catches per hour and an average of 19.5 grenwall spikes per catch. At level 99 Hunter, it's possible to achieve up to 370 catches per hour.

The bonecrusher, seedicide, and herbicide can be used to clean up drops from the grenwalls to conserve inventory space. Wielding the Hunter's Catalyst fragment or Combined Catalyst Fragment will automatically reset the player's box traps when they are triggered but fail to catch a creature. The catalyst fragments require completion of Sliske's Endgame to obtain. If owned, use of the volcanic trapper outfit is highly recommended as it gives a 7% increased success chance, 10% chance of double loot, allows 6 box traps to be placed at once, and gives a 30% chance to instantly deploy/pick up traps. A super hunter or extreme hunter potion could also be used to boost your Hunter level.

Making combat bracelets can be a fast and highly profitable way to train both Crafting and Magic as they are a popular item to cast High Level Alchemy on. Buy 1,000 dragonstones, gold bars and cosmic runes from the grand exchange then deposit the gold bars in your metal bank at a furnace and craft dragonstone bracelets. Then, cast Enchant Level 5 Jewellery on the dragonstone bracelets to make combat bracelets.

details:

activity: Making extra fine sand with Telekinetic Grind
item:
* to save 10% law runes
*  to grind 28 sandstone at once
*  for 6% extra crafting exp
details:
The experience and profit assumes the usage of the listed optional items. If one or more of these items aren't used, the profit and experience may be lower than expected. 

As the amount of sandstone ground in an hour exceeds the buy limit of 10,000 an hour, sandstone needs to be either bought from other players, or bought ahead of time, before using this money making method. Grinding one specific type of sandstone might earn the player more gp/hr than grinding all types of sandstone equally. Though, due to the buy limit of 10,000, all sandstone types are listed to allow this method to work more consistently.

Approximately 2,000 inventories can be processed in an hour, assuming an average of to process an inventory. It is theoretically possible to process up to 6,000 inventories per hour, though this would require robot-like click precision and no mistakes or lag.

The following setup involves the least amount of clicking for processing large amounts of Extra Fine Sand in 3 ticks.
* Stand at a one-click bank (such as the one in War's retreat).
* Zoom in so that the clickable area of the bank is as large as possible.
* Place the inventory on your screen so that it is right next to the bank. This way, the mouse only needs to move by a tiny bit to navigate between the bank and the inventory window.
* Place Telekinetic Grind on an action bar slot for which the key bind is easily accessible.
* Create a preset containing 28 of the same type of sandstone to grind. Make sure this preset uses the same key bind as the previous step

Now, use the following steps to grind the sandstone.
* Click to open the bank (tick 1)
* Press key bind to load the preset (tick 2)
* As soon as the bank closes, press the key bind button again and select the sandstone in the inventory (tick 3)

With a bit of practice, a player can get very consistent at grinding an inventory of sand in only 3 game ticks.

A similar setup for faster processing looks like:
* Press key bind and click a sandstone to process it
* On the same tick, right-click the bank to load your last preset
* Repeat

This method doesn't require a bank screen to appear or disappear, theoretically saving 2 ticks, though it requires much more precision to click on smaller targets without mistake.

details: Pick up eggs at Fred's Farm. Once you enter the farm, close the gate behind you and kill all the chickens outside the gate using cheap ranged/magic weapons (such as a chargebow or air staff). Chickens will then only respawn and spawn eggs inside the gate. Stay at the centre of the farm, and area loot as eggs shows up. It is recommended to keybind area loot to make picking up eggs easier.

details:
Players can collect a lot of eggs from the larder in a player-owned house in a short period of time. Stand between the sink space and the larder so that the servant always returns to the same location. To collect eggs from the larder:
# Hold down "3"
# Click the larder every 1 tick (or spam click) until inventory has at least 26 eggs
# Call the servant for the first time (after the first inventory just click on the servant)
# Use an egg on the butler and type how many eggs to transfer to your bank
# Rinse and repeat

If the player does not have access to the mind-controlled monkey butler other servants can be used but they have to be paid once every 8 banking trips. Lower tier servants also carry fewer eggs per trip and have a longer banking time. The banking time can potentially become longer than the time needed for one to withdraw eggs from the larder.

Use any anvil to forge adamant bars into dart tips. Noted adamant bars can be added to the metal bank and then withdrawn, as adamant dart tips are stackable there is no need to bank. This guide assumes that you are using sign of the porter V, however another may be more cost effective; refer to the sign of the porter page for a break down. If you have a grace of the elves, it can prolong your trips by compacting up to 500 sign of the porter charges.

Travel to any necrite rock cluster, drink your perfect juju mining potion, summon your lava titan, equip your a sign of the porter and begin mining. While the perfect juju potion is in effect, each ore-receiving swing gives a 10% chance to gain a bottled stone spirit of the type of ore mined. The perfect juju potion will also restore your mining stamina to full for every necrite stone spirit consumed. The necrite stone spirit will add an extra ore for every ore you mine, gaining extra profit even if the cost of one necrite stone spirit is deducted. Equipping signs of the porter will allow the player to transfer all mined ores to the metal bank, consuming one charge per ore, including any additional ores gained from the necrite stone spirit. 

Assuming the player actively clicks on rockertunities while afking in-between they should gain around 450 necrite ores an hour. The player's Strength level will affect the rates also.

Further profit could be achieved via the following means:

* A grace of the elves allows Seren spirits to spawn and reward the player with an item from the rare drop table. It can also be charged with signs of the porter to bank items. However, be aware that the grace of the elves has a sunk cost as it becomes permanently untradeable once equipped for the first time.
* Having a Luck of the Dwarves equipped allows the player to obtain the best drops from Seren spirits and also increases the chance of getting metamorphic geodes.

details:
Starting from the Memorial to Guthix bank, withdraw at least 2 box traps (4 recommended) and head south towards the Ferret (Hunter) near Nikolaus. Capture 20 ferrets and bank them at the Memorial to Guthix before returning for a second inventory of 20 ferrets. This should take about 7 minutes with 2 box traps, or as little as 6 minutes with 4 traps. Make sure to bank the other 20 ferrets and your box traps. We will be taking 5 ferrets per inventory as "bad luck" protection, but acquiring an inventory of 32 rabbit feet should only take about 3 ferrets on average, so you may have up to 20 extra ferrets once finished.

After acquiring 40 ferrets, withdraw 5 ferrets, 4 rabbit snares, and 1 spirit terrorbird pouch. Head east to the rabbit holes in the Piscatoris Hunter area and summon your spirit terrorbird on the way. Place 4 traps directly east of the westernmost rabbit hole, and then begin spam-clicking the northernmost rabbit hole to "Flush" the hole with a ferret until the 4 rabbit snares are full. This can take anywhere from 4 flushes to 12 depending on which path the rabbits take. Check all 4 snares, and replace them. If you do have a Bonecrusher, drop Raw Rabbit after your snare is visually set up to be able to move one tick earlier while clearing your inventory, otherwise hotkey drop your 4 raw rabbits while moving back to the flushing hole, or while flushing. If you do not have a Bonecrusher, you will additionally have to drop or bury the Bones. After you have collected 12 rabbit feet and you do not have any snares in your inventory, press the button in the familiar window to deposit items into your familiar. As the familiar cannot hold ferrets, only rabbit feet will be taken as long as you do not have undeployed snares, or undropped bones or raw rabbit.

After your inventory and your familiar's inventory are filled, return to the Memorial to Guthix bank to empty your and your familiar's inventory, and withdraw 5 more ferrets and 4 rabbit snares. You should not have lost any rabbit snares, but you should be down between 2 and 4 ferrets on a normal inventory. One inventory of 32 rabbit feet should take about 6 to 7 minutes, including time to bank.

When your summoning points are low, teleport to a small obelisk to refill your summoning points after you have banked, and while you have ferrets and snares. One recommended location is the Tribute stone next to the Falador lodestone due to its low requirements. After that, lodestone teleport to Eagles' Peak and head north to the rabbit holes to continue your trips. Optionally, you can sip doses of Summoning potion while banking to save time.

Including the time to catch ferrets, players can expect about 8-9 inventories of 32 rabbit feet per hour assuming 4 traps, a spirit terrorbird, and Surge are used. The estimate used in the header is for 8, as consistently reaching 9 can be a more intensive task.

activity: Turning extra fine sand into blessed sand
details:
Blessed sand is extra fine sand that has been blessed by using it on any altar of Saradomin. It is part of the process of making blessed molten glass. It can be blessed by using the "bless" option while standing next to an altar, or by using it on the altar directly. The most convenient place to make blessed sand seems to be at the Lumbridge Church. 

The processing time is 2 ticks or 1.2 seconds per sand. This means in an hour (3,600 seconds) you can theoretically process 3,000 sand. The actual amount is closer to 2,800 depending on how AFK you are. Up to 60 blessed sand is made at a time. Knowing it takes 1.2 seconds per sand, you are able to AFK for 72 seconds between actions. 

Extra fine sand can be blessed at more Saradomin-aligned altars, including:
* Edgeville Monastery
* Lumbridge Church
* Entrana
* Abbey of St. Elspeth Citharede
* Everlight statues
* Saradominist player-owned house chapels

activity: Taking vials of water from a portable well
details:
Vials of water are often in high demand because they must be used with a herb in order to make an unfinished potion for the Herblore skill. Players often buy them in bulk.

A portable well can be placed next to a bank, and has a right click option to take vials of water. You then need to type the number of vials to be taken. The exact number does not need to be typed and as such typing 111 or 33 may be faster than typing 28 exactly, as any excess over the number of available inventory spaces will simply be ignored.

A bank preset with an empty inventory may be used to speed up collecting as activating the preset by hotkey will both empty the inventory of vials and close the bank interface. Using this method is is possible to obtain an inventory of vials in under 6 seconds, resulting in 16,800 vials of water per hour. This number may be higher with practice.

Bread dough is made by using a pot of flour on a jug of water. To avoid losing money test out the profit of making one bread dough before you do them in bulk.

Buy an equal number of pots of flour (which has a buying limit of 1,000 per four hours) and jugs of water from the Grand Exchange. Withdraw 9 pots of flour and 9 jugs of water and use one on the other. This will bring up a menu to make bread dough. Click mix. Once you've made 9, bank them and repeat. Making a bank preset can speed up banking times. Each inventory takes about 12 seconds (assuming you are using bank presets) which results in making about 2,700 bread dough per hour.

You can then sell the bread dough on the Grand Exchange. To maximise your profit, buy one bread dough at the instant price, and then sell all of yours for slightly below that price.

details:
After completing the quest Dragon Slayer, you may return to Duke Horacio on the of Lumbridge Castle at any time to obtain more Anti-dragon shields. The Duke will give you a new shield even if you already have one in your inventory, so the drop trick is not necessary for this method. Speak to the Duke and press the space bar to advance his dialogue, then press the "1" key to select the dialogue option "I seek a shield that will protect me from dragonbreath." Hold the space bar to advance the Duke's dialogue until he gives you a shield, then rinse and repeat. Alternatively, if you unlock your GUI, you can drag the NPC dialogue box so that it overlaps with the Duke. Doing this, you can simply hold down the space bar and click both the Duke and the shield dialogue option without needing to move your mouse. 

With high efficiency, you can obtain one shield in about four seconds. You can convert a full inventory of 27 (26 if you already have noted shields in your inventory) Anti-dragon shields into notes at the same time by using a shield on a piece of Magic notepaper. Take care not to left click on the shield, as this will equip it rather than using it. Obtaining at least 800 shields in an hour using Magic notepaper is possible with enough practise. The shields are in high demand so will often instantly sell on the GE.

details:
Use a mystical sand seed or regular sand seed to quickly teleport to the Garden of Kharid. Otherwise you can use a ring of duelling or the Al Kharid lodestone and run north. Once here, pickpocket either of the Crux Eqal Knights near the edges. 

Pickpocketing success chance decays over time (1% per 7.2 seconds after initial bonus success pickpockets), so stacking more buffs will allow the player a longer period before their success chance decreases below 100%. Players should generally aim for a 100% success time of 5 minutes, which is the time that the Crystal Mask spell lasts. Refreshing the spell also refreshes the player's success chance. Players may choose to employ one of the following strategies depending on their available buffs:
* Both Crystal Mask and Light Form: With both of these, players with the minimum Thieving level and no buffs have a 100% success rate for 3 minutes 42 seconds. Players should aim to reach 5 minutes (the refresh time of Crystal Mask) by adding the at least +11% success chance in other buffs or Thieving levels. Players will need both runes and prayer upkeep supplies.
* Crystal Mask only: Players can reach 5 minutes of 100% success rate with +26% in other buffs or Thieving levels. Players using this method do not need to upkeep prayer points.
* No Crystal Mask: Players with most or all available buffs and a high level will have a high enough success chance that they no longer need to use Crystal Mask. This allows for AFK times longer than five minutes.

Damage will be taken if the player gets caught before refreshing their pickpocketing, but this can be outhealed by natural life point regeneration if using the above strategies. If your 100% success time is significantly lower than 5 minutes, consider bringing an enhanced Excalibur for additional healing.

The base maximum pickpocketing rate is 3000 per hour if using the Sticky Fingers relic and 2000 per hour otherwise. The master camouflage outfit provides a 7% chance to double the loot, resulting in loot equivalent to 3210 pickpockets per hour, not taking movement into account. For the other camouflage outfits, the chance is 5%. If not using Sticky Fingers, the mushroomy pickpocketing bag has a 5% chance to speed up pickpocketing by one tick, increasing the rate from 2000 to 2034 pickpockets per hour. The experience gain remains roughly the same with or without the Sticky Fingers relic as the experience per pickpocket is adjusted. About a +1% success chance boost is needed with the relic to reach the same AFK times as the change to the success chance decay per pickpocket does not account for the sped up initial bonus success pickpockets.

With sufficiently high Thieving and Agility levels, the player will have a chance to pickpocket multiple loot at once:
* Double loot at 93 Thieving and 83 Agility
* Triple loot at 103 Thieving and 93 Agility
This additional loot is not factored into the above rates as the exact chance to multiply loot is not known. However, it is fairly common.

Check the calculator below for the buffs that you will need to reach the target AFK times. Note that the soul-in-a-box is not recommended as it must be refreshed every minute.

activity: Mining limestone and crafting into limestone bricks
details: With the release of Fort Forinthry, limestone has gone up in price. The limestone mine that is most easily accessible is the Silvarea quarry, which can be reached rather quickly with the Skeletal horror Teleport or the invitation box. Mining the limestone rock once around half-way through each backpack to keep mining stamina high to maintain maximum mining speed. Craft your full backpack of limestone into limestone bricks. There is a deposit box close by, south, next to Maria, since limestone does not store in an ore box.

Paladins are a more accessible NPC for pickpocketing money making with two distinct advantages:
# Their only loot is coins and chaos runes, the latter of which is relatively price stable. This means that players will not need to bank their loot or require the Thieving cape to note it.
# Being in Ardougne, players only need to complete the medium Ardougne achievements to obtain the +10% success chance buff, instead of the hard Ardougne achievements, significantly reducing the barrier to entry.
They can be found in Ardougne castle and Ardougne market. Pickpocketing them in the castle is recommended as they are easier to trap in a corner, preventing movement. Pickpocketing in Ardougne market has an advantage in that it is nearer a bank, but players should have ample inventory space to bring food without needing to get more from the bank.

With the medium Ardougne achievements completed, a magpie familiar, and the gloves of silence (upgrade to the Trahaearn exoskeleton set or preferably the Master camouflage outfit if owned), players at level 75 Thieving will have a 100% success chance time of 2 minutes 53 seconds. This can be increased significantly with levels and/or the finger discount unlocks, providing players with a significant amount of AFK time without having to meet the higher requirements of Crystal Mask. 

The base maximum pickpocketing rate is 3000 per hour if using the Sticky Fingers relic and 2000 per hour otherwise. If owned, the master camouflage outfit provides a 7% chance to double the loot, while for other camouflage outfits the chance is 5%. The experience gain remains roughly the same with or without the Sticky Fingers relic as the experience per pickpocket is adjusted. About a +1% success chance boost is needed with the relic to reach the same AFK times as the change to the success chance decay per pickpocket does not account for the sped up initial bonus success pickpockets.

activity: Generating compost with a compost mound familiar
other: Buckets All the Way Down upgrade from Sydekix's Shop of Balance
details:
It's recommended to complete this method in Taverley, just north of the Player-owned house portal, where the Tool leprechaun stands right next to the compost bin. The tool leprechaun at this location will also never move from his position. Each use of the scroll requires 12 special move points, which regenerate back normally in slightly less than 22 seconds, allowing the player to use approximately 167 scrolls per hour without the use of any special move boosting effects. A compost mound familiar lasts 36 minutes without any extensions.

Buckets All the Way Down upgrade allows players to draw compost from the compost bin without requiring any buckets, and is therefore ultimately required for maximum profit and uptime. This can be bought at Sydekix's Shop of Balance for 10,000 Crux Eqal favour.

When the special move bar is regenerating, you should take compost from the bin and right-click 'Exchange' with the tool leprechaun to store all the compost with him, you may then right click the stored buckets to withdraw them in noted form at any point. The compost bin will hold a maximum of 1000 processed compost of each type, so it is not possible to do an entire hour without drawing any buckets from the bin. 

The amounts of compost and super compost are slightly random, as the scroll generates super compost instead at about 1 in 10 times, but both types are generated 15 at a time. The Compost Mound familiar will also generate compost and super compost into its inventory every once in a while, which can be withdrawn for slightly more profit in total.

details:
Deposit the gold bars into the metal bank at the furnace. Create a bank preset with an inventory filled with 28 dragonstones. Run to the furnace and use it to craft an inventory of dragonstone rings. Run back to bank, reload your preset and repeat. 

The Workshop in Fort Forinthry contains the closest furnace to any bank in RuneScape, and also contains multiple other useful utilities, including two anvils and forges, an inventor's workbench, remote access to Invention machines (at tier 2 or 3), an archaeologist's workbench and a sawmill. Skilling here will also allow players to gain additional bonus experience over time via rested XP, granted that the Town Hall is built in the fort as well. Requires completion of New Foundations to access.

Full process requires 4 actions per minute:

# Click the furnace
# Press space to begin project
# Click banker (after crafting)
# Press bank preset to reload it

These actions account for roughly 8 seconds. 52 seconds are spent waiting for the rings to craft.

Put War's Retreat Teleport on your main skilling/non-combat action bar and have that as your primary bar. Right click on your (equipped) explorer's ring 3, cabbage-port, then start plucking in organised fashion so you can always walk two steps over to the next cabbage. Going across rows each time is advised. Once your inventory is full, teleport to War's Retreat and go to the bank chest. Hit 3 to bank-all and Esc to exit with your cursor already on your explorer's ring. Repeat.

As an alternative for free players without the War's Retreat Teleport, the Skull of Remembrance from the quest The Death of Chivalry can be used to teleport close to a bank chest.

Low-level players should beware Goblin Raids spawning on the cabbage patch, although Goblin Raiders are not aggressive.

Memory shards may be obtained from pickpocketing, checking hunter traps, or planting seeds, when the relevant passive perk (for each method) is active from the Memorial to Guthix. When memory shards are earned, it will prompt the message "You find a small fragment of a memory".

Memory shards can also be obtained in the Hall of Memories while harvesting memories when the buff from getting close to a recollection butterfly is active.

Each time you obtain memory shards the amount varies, so it's possible to get as low as 400 and as high as 800 per hour depending on luck. For this guide 600 memory shards has been used as an average obtained per hour.

Memory shards can be converted into porters, with the best conversation rate being Sign of the porter IV with 1.25 charges per shard. This equates to per charge costing . From the table below, it's better profit to sell made Portent of restoration VII's and buy porter supplies, than convert shards into porters.

Harmonic dust can be obtained by playing harps within the Ithell district of Prifddinas. Harps are a very low effort way of training crafting, and the harmonic dust has many uses. Once you have acquired all of the crystal items you need, the dust can be made into items and sold for profit - this is a nice supplementary income whilst training crafting. If you're planning on staying at harps for many hours, it's worth buying crystal armour seeds or crystal weapon seeds earlier than you need as they can take awhile to buy on the GE. Approximately 750 dust can be obtained an hour without VoS (or artificer's measure) at level 99 Crafting.

Stone wall segments can be made at the workshop in Fort Forinthry using the stonecutter. This guide assumes it take around 25 second to take the bricks from the bank, use them on the stonecutter and repeat.

Gelatinous abominations are found in the Burthorpe Slayer Cave in Ewean's Grove, just south-west of Taverley's stone circle. Spiked gauntlets, available to buy for 6 coins from any Slayer master, are required in order to kill them. Turael offers Spiked gauntlets free of charge. The gauntlets must be worn, not just be in the inventory.

Due to the death animation, it may be tempting to attack multiple gelatinous abominations at once. But you will need to go back and finish off each one to get the dropped loot.

Dinosaur eggs can be collected quickly from the Seggregation activity by collecting eggs from the pile of dinosaur eggs and destroying the good and bad eggs. This allows the dinosaur eggs which are occasionally found during this activity to be obtained rapidly as there is no need to move between stations in order to produce sharp shell shards. One good/bad egg is obtained per 2 tick allowing for up to 0 good/bad eggs per hour each giving a chance at a dinosaur egg. Approximately 0 dinosaur eggs can be obtained per hour in this manner and they can be stored in Beasts of Burden or banked with winter storage scrolls or a legendary pets banking ability.

This guide assumes 1200 eggs converted per hour. Obtained numbers will not be exact but very approximate, as converting eggs gives randomly between 12 to 15 shards each.

Dive/Bladed Dive and Surge are very useful to travel between the pile, compost bin and incubator deposits, which may increase hourly yield, but also increasing intensity.

Using the Shadow-Touched set may also increase XP gained, but in this method, it is possible to use Grace of the elves, as collecting the eggs gives 1 Farming experience, triggering the appearance of the Seren spirit.

Thanks to the quickly ticking Farming exp, this method may also be useful to collect Master farmer fragments.

The usage of a Beast of Burden is also possible, reducing necessary trips to the egg pile, but since the distance between deposits is small, its impact is relatively small.

details:
This guide assumes kills per hour, on a slayer task. Your actual profit may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

Off-task: Blast diffusion boots, 1/8000, 

They use highly damaging ranged attacks against the player, so it is recommended to use Protect/Deflect Range whilst fighting them.

Liverworts use ranged attacks against the player. After performing ten auto-attacks (24 seconds), the liverworts drag the player next to it, stunning and binding them for four seconds while shooting out three spores in front of them. If the player doesn't move away within the allotted time, then the spores explode on them and deal 1,368 poison damage times three spores, while healing the liverworts for the same amount. If the player moves away from the liverworts, then the spores explode and damage the liverworts for the same amount of damage.

Using Freedom or Anticipation right before the special attack will cause the liverworts to spin and shoot their spores in the opposite direction of the player. Alternatively, using Freedom while stunned by the special attack and running away will cause the liverworts to take the damage alone.

Even with use of Protect/Deflect Range alongside devotion, an Enhanced Excalibur, and Vampyrism, expect to still need to eat. Bring a Blood reaver (familiar) with Blood Reaver scroll (Blood Siphon) to stay for longer periods of time.

Grapes spawn on the top floor of the Cooks' Guild. Due to the long respawn time, this method requires world switching to gather grapes more quickly.

Each trip takes 7.5 minutes, or 8 trips per hour. This may vary significantly based on how fast world switching can be done.

While there is also a spawn for grapes in the Phoenix Gang Hideout, it is further from a bank.

Players can also use magic notepaper to note the grapes, eliminating banking time, for an estimated per hour; the cost effectiveness would vary depending on the market for both items.

Alternatively, players can kill guards and receive them as a drop, earning around  per hour, assuming the Killing guards strategy.

If you do not want to switch worlds, you can use another method in conjunction, such as Fletching headless arrows, because Fletching doesn't require banking or a lot of inventory spaces. Profit varies depending on the combinations of methods.

Buy buckets of milk in The Milk Shop, from the milk seller in Falador farm, for 12 coins each. Bank with War's Retreat Teleport, then use the explorer's ring 3 to return.

There are 200 in stock, but this is a non-personalised shop; each world has a separate stock, so you can keep buying them indefinitely with enough worlds to cycle from and no competition. It takes 7 runs to get 196 buckets of milk in a world before hopping. Each world takes about 3 minutes and 45 seconds (225 seconds). That is 16 worlds per hour, or 3136 buckets of milk per hour.

The Milk Shop takes 100 minutes to fully restock, so you need about 27 worlds to do this continuously.

This can be done with no teleports, but would be much slower. Each world would take about 6 minutes (depositing milk at the bank deposit box in Port Sarim), for a theoretical per hour, but in practice it would be less as it takes far more running and your energy would eventually deplete.

War's Retreat Teleport for banking can be substituted for the slower but practically requirements-free Archaeology journal. Either should only be used if the explorer ring 3 is available, as there are no other practical teleports to the Falador farm.

Theoretically magic notepaper can be used to note buckets of milk on the spot so banking is unnecessary ( profit per bucket of milk), but there are only 32 free-to-play worlds, insufficient to sustain such an extreme rate of stock consumption (~100 worlds are needed). While stock lasts, a world can be cleared in 1 minute, theoretically amounting to an effective profit of  per hour.

activity: Making Blood Reaver scroll (Blood Siphon)s during the Voice of Seren in the Amlodd district
details:
The best way to make scrolls is at the Amlodd obelisk during the Amlodd Voice of Seren. Begin by summoning a Beast of Burden, then withdraw 28 pouches into both your inventory and your familiar. Use the attuned crystal teleport seed to teleport to the Amlodd district, and run to the Obelisk. Use your pouches on the obelisk, and they will be made into scrolls. Withdraw from your familiar, and use your pouches on the obelisk again. Teleport to a bank by using the attuned crystal teleport seed to travel to Ithell (8) or Trahaearn (0). Bank your scrolls and repeat. Each run takes 30 seconds, so you can use around 7,200 pouches per hour using a pack yak.

You can decrease the travel time and increase the overall profit per hour by keybinding your Attuned crystal teleport seed as well as using the Surge ability with the Mobile perk.

Picking up glowing fungus and dropping it turns it into ashes, highly valued for Necromancy as an ingredient of ghostly ink. The Underworld Grimoire is required as it automatically banks any ashes picked up and the glowing fungus is very remote. Once you have picked up a piece of the fungus, drag and drop it onto your action bar. Once it is bound to a key, you can hold that key indefinitely and any fungus you hold and further pick would automatically be dropped. Click the dropped ashes to open the loot interface, then you can use space to loot and bank all ashes on the ground at once. One inventory can be banked in about 36 seconds, or 100 loads in 1 hour (although you don't have to bank 28 ashes exactly every time). Glowing fungus regrows almost instantly.

These rates assume you use a Brooch of the Gods, 3 pieces of the factory outfit, a modified botanist's mask, scroll of cleansing, and a portable well. This guide also assumes it takes 3 seconds to bank per inventory.

When you have all your supplies, head to world 84 Fort Forinthry if you're not using your own portable wells. It is possible to further boost your potions made per hour by using a beast of burden such as a pack yak along with presets. 

After all your potions are made, head to any decanting NPC such as War in War's Retreat or Bob Barter (herbs) in the Grand Exchange and have him decant your Saradomin brew (3) into Saradomin brew flask.

Cadava berries are valuable as ingredients in Necromancy potions. They can be picked from cadava bushes south of Varrock. There are 3 of them with 2 berries each, or 6 in total.

Due to the long respawn time, this method requires world switching to gather berries more quickly. The gathering speed would depend on how fast world switching can be done.

After 5 worlds, you should have 28 berries. Banking is fastest with War's Retreat Teleport, then use Archaeology journal to teleport back. If you have not unlocked War's Retreat Teleport, you can bank with the journal. 25 runs are possible in 1 hour.

Cadava berries are in high demand and the bushes are not instanced, so there might be occasional competition making it take longer to gather berries.

Excavate Tsutsaroth remains and destroy artefacts while selling all material gained. Only need to click about once every 7 minutes if you have the 10 minutes auto logout so that it starts a new artefact. Profit could be increased using anything that makes you use fewer signs of the porter, an XP capacitor, or a waterfiend familiar if desired. This method is meant to be a near-afk guide for solo normal mode Kerapac. The only necessary inputs are surging to collect the loot and making sure your overload reservoir, weapon poison and Darkness are up, and activating enhanced excalibur or ancient elven ritual shard in the instance that your hp or prayer gets low.

* This method heavily relies on poison procs and conjure damage. Replacing First necromancer robes for Deathwarden will make this method unreliable and more dangerous, due to the risk of dying to Kerapac's slam attack. The weapons could be switched for T90 instead, although T95 is strongly recommended.
* Vulnerability bombs are used at the start of the kill and Invoke Death is used during a phase transition to minimise DPS loss during the fight, but neither are necessary, as they only help to get faster and safer kills.
*Vampyrism aspect along with powder of penance are preferred, for increased blood reaver poison procs and general prayer and hp sustain with minimal inputs from the player.
*Essence of Finality doesn't have any special stored used, and is solely used for the better stats. It can easily be switched to an Amulet of souls for a reduced repair cost.

The following Revolution bar was used for this method.

Ascendri bolts (e) have a relatively high High Alchemy price and a high trade volume, so many players put them in the Alchemiser mk. II for passive profit.

The Enchant Crossbow Bolt (Ascendri) spell enchants 10 bolts at a time, using one cosmic rune, one death rune and 20 fire runes. Use a staff of fire for free fire runes. Click the Enchant Crossbow Bolt magic spell, which opens a menu to enchant bolts. 60 sets of 10 bolts can be made using the menu, taking approximately 142 seconds. This gives a theoretical upper limit of 15,000 enchanted Ascendri bolts per hour. As all inputs and outputs are stackable, there is no requirement to bank and this technique can be done anywhere.

If you prefer a more active method, it is possible using Tick manipulation to quadruple your profit and magic XP, by clicking on the Enchant Crossbow Bolt spell each Game tick, and confirming each click with your space bar. This method is high-intensity and is only maintanable over short periods of time, however it can be useful for clearing through your GE limit of bolts to fill Alchemiser mk. II.

The bolt market is fairly volatile, so test the profit of one set of bolts before you buy the runes and bolts in bulk. Maximise your profit by buying one Ascendri bolt (e) instantly, and sell all of yours for slightly less than what you paid. They may take a while to sell, but an extra 100 coins per bolt can double your profit.

The perk from the Fletching cape and the tier 2 and 3 of the Ranger's Workroom grant 0.75% and 1% chance to make an extra bundle of headless dinarrows with every action, respectively. However, a portable fletcher doesn't provide any benefit when making headless dinarrows.

Even though headless dinarrows don't use feathers, the "Headless Chicken" perk from having hens placed in a pen in the player-owned farm grants 3% to 5% chance to save half of the dinosaur 'propellant' used with each action. This can help save up to 1,200 dinosaur 'propellant' out of 45,000 normally used per hour, increasing hourly profit.

Due to the buy limit of the ingredients being lower than what you can produce in an hour, you may need to buy from other players or leave in GE offers overnight or longer.

At level 95 Necromancy, players can perform Manifest ectoplasm rituals to create ectoplasm, an important ingredient used in Necromancy combat. The limiting factor of this money making method is gathering buckets of slime, which are untradable. The fastest way to gather buckets of slime is to bring a stack of Magic notepaper to the pool below the Ectofuntus, where you can gather buckets in the first  minutes of your hour. It's recommended to gather much more than  buckets per trip to save time banking. It is currently not possible to use the notepaper on the buckets, but you can use the bucket on the notepaper to convert the buckets into bank notes.

A cheaper way to gather buckets of slime (without Magic notepaper) is to use Morytania legs 2, Morytania legs 3, or Morytania legs 4 which grant 5, 10, or unlimited free daily teleports to the Ectofuntus slime pool, respectively. If using a Pack yak and Morytania legs 4, it is possible to gather  buckets of slime in about  minutes. This method saves  for about 2 hours worth of rituals, but can only be performed once per day.

The maximum number of ectoplasms per ritual is, which requires the following:
* Place 3  glyphs on the ritual site ( required but can be boosted)
* Wear an Alteration necklace
* Wear a Necromancy cape attuned to  ( required)

The buckets of slime can be converted in  rituals using the remainder of the hour, yielding 0 ectoplasm per hour.

Use a furnace to smelt luminite and adamant ore into adamant bars. Ore and bars can be added to the metal bank and then withdrawn, so there is no need to bank.

Then use any anvil to forge adamant bars into arrowheads. You can queue up smithing multiple sets of arrowheads by right clicking the anvil, choosing "open smithing interface" and selecting adamant arrowheads until you have a full inventory of unfinished smithing items. You will then start to smith the arrowheads, automatically starting to smith the next unfinished item as each is completed. Maintain high heat by using a forge to progress in creating arrowheads at the fastest rate. 

Although smithing adamant arrowheads only requires level 40 Smithing, level 49 Smithing is recommended in order to create each unfinished smithing item with the highest possible heat available, maximising the number of arrowheads smithed per hour.

Note that smelting the bars takes a little under 3 minutes per hour, resulting in slightly fewer arrowheads made per hour than making the arrowheads directly from bars.

Use any anvil to forge adamant bars into arrowheads. Noted adamant bars can be added to the metal bank and then withdrawn, as adamant arrowheads are stackable there is no need to bank. You can queue up smithing multiple sets of arrowheads by right clicking the anvil, choosing "open smithing interface" and selecting adamant arrowheads until you have a full inventory of unfinished smithing items. The first 20 minutes of the hour should be spent on creating Binding contracts. Approximately 36 empty binding pouches can be made per minute with the necessary materials using a yak and attuned crystal teleport seed at the Prifddinas summoning obelisk. This results in around 700 binding contracts ready to use.

The remaining 40 minutes should be spent in combat fighting the Hellhounds. Bring all binding pouches, along with the Oldak coil, holy overload, magic notepaper, and optionally food into the Taverley hellhound resource dungeon.  Use melee (scythe-like weapon), soul split, and T95 prayers when attacking the hellhounds. Hellhounds tend to not have any great drops, so it may not be worth the time to pick them up, although the player might want to bring along a Charos' clue carrier to pick up the hard clue scrolls.

Ratio between the time spent creating pouches compared to the time spent in combat should be adjusted per player and may vary depending on gear used.

Moss golems exclusively use melee attacks, with a halberd-type range attack, and deal extremely high damage. During the fight, if the moss golem takes too long to kill, it will say *glug glug*, throwing its head into a random spot near it. Audible popping sounds will be heard when it does this. If it is still not killed, the head will turn into a level 91 mossy rock that will assist the golem in dealing damage. This can be avoided by standing on top of the tile that the head appears on. Killing the moss golem will also kill all mossy rocks it summoned.

Stand near the north-west hill and place your oldak coil down. You will want to be in a spot, hugging the hill, so that fewer moss golems can surround the player. Pray protect/deflect melee, item protect, and turmoil. The coil will pull the moss golems in, use AoE abilities to kill them with area loot toggled so you do not have to move far from your spot.

Equipment siphons are used to train Invention, and they are always in demand. Equipment siphons are used to extracts Invention experience from an augmented item without destroying it.

Disassembling items into simple parts is a mostly-AFK activity, making this method great for when you do not want to pay much attention to the game while still turning a profit. Maple logs disassemble into simple parts at a rate of 49%. This method will be more effective with higher junk chance reduction levels, unlocked by training the Invention skill. An auto disassembler or auto disassembler mk. II can be used to increase the flow of simple parts.

Refer to the calculator pages, Calculator:Disassembly by material/Dextrous and Calculator:Disassembly by material/Precious to search for the best items for dextrous components and precious components. Most of the time, black salamander or strung magic shortbow are best items to be disassembled into dextrous components. Gems, for example ruby, diamond, and especially ring of slaying are best items to be disassembled into precious components.

Eternal magic logs can be cut from the eternal magic trees which are located in Piscatoris Hunter area. When cutting trees occasionally a ray of light and falling leaves will appear on one side of the tree. Moving to this side will give a 30-second Lumberjack's Intuition buff, giving an increased chance to perform a Perfect Cut which guarantees that logs will be obtained. The buff also increases the chance to obtain bird's nests and a chance to obtain enchanted bird's nests, which may contain valuable rewards. The buff is enhanced with at least level 104 Woodcutting. The experience gained from woodcutting scales with the player's Woodcutting level. The trees last for five minutes before they are cut down, making this a low intensity money maker. 

The perfect juju woodcutting potion grants a 5% boost to logs gained and 1 dose is used per hour.

activity: Spinning starbloom cloth from starbloom flowers
details:
First, spin starbloom flower into starbloom thread at a spinning wheel.

The spinning wheel in the Ranger's Workroom (at least tier 1) in Fort Forinthry is right next to a bank, so it's an optimal location for this. 

Next, weave starbloom thread into starbloom cloth at any loom. 

Both starbloom thread and starbloom cloth are stackable, so it's wise to process all of your starbloom flower into starbloom thread first, and then process all of that starbloom thread into starbloom cloth at once.

details:
Use a TokKul-Zo to quickly teleport to the Main Plaza of TzHaar City. If not owned, use the Karamja lodestone and run through Brimhaven to the volcano entrance. Once here, pickpocket either of the TzHaar-Hur traders near the northern corners of the main plaza. 

Pickpocketing success chance decays over time (1% per 7.2 seconds after initial bonus success pickpockets), so stacking more buffs will allow the player a longer period before their success chance decreases below 100%. Players should generally aim for a 100% success time of 5 minutes, which is the time that the Crystal Mask spell lasts. Refreshing the spell also refreshes the player's success chance. Players may choose to employ one of the following strategies depending on their available buffs:
* Both Crystal Mask and Light Form: With both of these, players with the minimum Thieving level and no buffs have a 100% success rate for 4 minutes. Players should aim to reach 5 minutes (the refresh time of Crystal Mask) by adding the at least +9% success chance in other buffs or Thieving levels. Players will need both runes and prayer upkeep supplies.
* Crystal Mask only: Players can reach 5 minutes of 100% success rate with +24% in other buffs or Thieving levels. Players using this method do not need to upkeep prayer points.
* No Crystal Mask: Players with most or all available buffs and a high level will have a high enough success chance that they no longer need to use Crystal Mask. If using a luck relic to allow use of the ring of Vitur, players can achieve AFK times of slightly over 5 minutes without the spell.

The base maximum pickpocketing rate is 3000 per hour if using the Sticky Fingers relic and 2000 per hour otherwise. The master camouflage outfit provides a 7% chance to double the loot, resulting in loot equivalent to 3210 pickpockets per hour, not taking movement into account. For the other camouflage outfits, the chance is 5%. If not using Sticky Fingers, the mushroomy pickpocketing bag has a 5% chance to speed up pickpocketing by one tick, increasing the rate from 2000 to 2034 pickpockets per hour. The experience gain remains roughly the same with or without the Sticky Fingers relic as the experience per pickpocket is adjusted. About a +3% success chance boost is needed with the relic to reach the same AFK times as the change to the success chance decay per pickpocket does not account for the sped up initial bonus success pickpockets.

Tier 2 or higher luck boosts the chance of receiving the Jal-tok-yt, which makes up a large chunk of the profit. Thus, it is recommended to use a luck ring or relic if possible, with Tier 4 luck giving the highest chance. Using a relic will allow players to use the ring of Vitur instead, but this may not be necessary depending on your other buffs.

The profit listed on this guide does not take into account the reward value of the clue scrolls obtained, which can provide a significant boost to the total loot when completed. In addition, this is a useful way of passively obtaining Tokkul that can be used to recharge the Tokkul-Zo and Fight cauldron coffer buff.

Check the calculator below for the buffs that you will need to reach the target AFK times. Note that the soul-in-a-box is not recommended as it must be refreshed every minute.

Pickpocketing success chance decays over time (1% per 7.2 seconds after initial bonus success pickpockets), so stacking more buffs will allow the player a longer period before their success chance decreases below 100%. Players should generally aim for a 100% success time of 5 minutes, which is the time that the Crystal Mask spell lasts. Refreshing the spell also refreshes the player's success chance. Players may choose to employ one of the following strategies depending on their available buffs:
* Both Crystal Mask and Light Form: With both of these, players with the minimum Thieving level and no buffs have a 100% success rate for 4 minutes. Players should aim to reach 5 minutes (the refresh time of Crystal Mask) by adding the at least +9% success chance in other buffs or Thieving levels. Players will need both runes and prayer upkeep supplies.
* Crystal Mask only: Players can reach 5 minutes of 100% success rate with +24% in other buffs or Thieving levels. Players using this method do not need to upkeep prayer points.
* No Crystal Mask: Players with most or all available buffs and a high level will have a high enough success chance that they no longer need to use Crystal Mask. This allows for AFK times slightly longer than five minutes.

Damage will be taken if the player gets caught before refreshing their pickpocketing, but this can be outhealed by natural life point regeneration if using the above strategies.

Using the Dungeoneering cape, Dungeoneering master cape, or the Hoardstalker ring, teleport to Al Kharid resource dungeon, but do not enter the dungeon. Mine any one of several common gem rocks available. With a full inventory, teleport close to a bank, such as Edgeville lodestone, and repeat. details:
The profit rate assumes kills per hour. Your actual profits may be higher or lower depending on your speed.

The giant mole is the sole drop source of the numbing root, each of which sells for .

Magic is the most efficient way of dealing with the Giant Mole - magic armour will best resist the Giant Mole's melee attacks, and the Giant Mole has the weakest defence against Magic.

Pursue the Giant Mole throughout her chambers, and use magic throughout the kill. In mini-mole sections, use Chain and Dragon Breath to leave at most 1 mini-mole alive before refocusing on the Giant Mole again. Use enhanced abilities for damage output when possible, unless you need to take out mini-moles first or are waiting on the Giant Mole to Berserk in the northeastern chamber (and thus need to preserve stuns). Wild Magic can be used to cause burst damage before mini-mole summons, or to push excess damage into the mole's next phase. Adrenaline stall as needed when moving between chambers, trapped in mud (Anticipation and Freedom can still be used while trapped), or between kills.

Due to magic free-to-play weapons being at most tier 55, only air runes to cast Air Blast are necessary - stronger Blast spells will provide no further benefits due to magic damage being capped by the weapon's tier.

Similar approaches can also be performed with two-handed melee weapons, though this will have comparatively higher Attack requirements versus Magic to avoid losing hit chance (85 Attack for 100% hit chance using gravite weapons).

Food requirements can vary greatly between fights due to the nature of the mole's final phase - getting certain patterns such as Berserk and Rockfall simultaneously can result in large amounts of unavoidable damage. Consider using Devotion or Debilitate in response to such patterns to limit the damage you'll take.

If food supplies outlast available prayer points to maintain Protect from Melee, a prayer potion or twisted bird skull necklace can be brought to sustain trips.

activity: Shearing sheep and spinning balls of wool
image: Shearing Sheep To Balls Of Wool.png
details:
Start by teleporting to Burthorpe. Walk south until you hit the sheep pen (across from the cows near Burthorpe mine. Shear the sheep until your inventory is full. Walk straight to the spinning wheel (north of the cow pen) and turn it into balls of wool. Walk north to the bank chest and deposit it. The whole process takes about 2:29. Rinse and repeat for as long as you like. Once you're ready, teleport to the Exchange and sell them.

Each trip takes 2.5 minutes, or 24 trips per hour, with a full backpack of 28 balls of wool per trip.

details:
This profit rate assumes kills per hour. The loot shown averages the minimum and maximum possible of each individual common drop, and assumes equal drop rates between all of them.

Please refer to the strategy guide for information on the recommended gear. Players should create a private instance with spawn speed set to the fastest. Use the following prayers - Incredible Reflexes, Ultimate Strength, Steel Skin, and Protect from Magic. After each kill players can teleport to War's Retreat and restore prayer with the Altar of War. If health is needed food can be eaten or restored at the bank chest. Then run down to the adrenaline crystals and charge until max adrenaline. Enter the boss portal and rejoin the created instance. Usage of either freedom or anticipation is needed to prevent adrenaline from starting to deplete until KBD spawns. 

Alternatively, players with high enough combat stats can enter from the Lava Maze Dungeon for the 10% damage boost if they wish and bring prayer potions with the recommended gear. Using the same prayers as above will allow the player to stay in the instance for the entire duration without having to leave. 

Actual profit per hour will be lower if using prayer potions or gravite weaponry due to the cost of repair. Using one piece of gravite will add an extra 50,000 coins per hour to the costs.

Giant chinchompas take slightly longer to kill, however the meat obtained is more valuable potentially offering larger profits. The quantities of apex hide and raw giant chinchompa meat stated here assume that giant golden chinchompas are hunted.

Giant kebbits can be hunted faster than their chinchompa counterparts allowing for more meat and hides to be gathered in the same amount of time. The quantities of apex hide and raw giant kebbit meat stated here assume that giant dashing kebbits are hunted.

Note: While it is possible to pickpocket gnomes at level 75 Thieving, level 99 Thieving is strongly recommended for the Thieving cape to note the very common swamp toad and king worm drops. Pickpocketing is still viable without it but it becomes a high attention method as the player will have to frequently bank (losing time) or drop (losing significant profit in swamp toads) these items.

Pickpocket Gnomes at the Tree Gnome Stronghold.

Pickpocketing success chance decays over time (1% per 7.2 seconds after initial bonus success pickpockets), so stacking more buffs will allow the player a longer period before their success chance decreases below 100%. Players should generally aim for a 100% success time of 5 minutes, which is the time that the Crystal Mask spell lasts. Refreshing the spell also refreshes the player's success chance. Players may choose to employ one of the following strategies depending on their available buffs:
* Crystal Mask only: At level 99 Thieving, players can reach 5 minutes of 100% success rate with +2% in other buffs or Thieving levels. Since the player is already close to 5 minutes, the strategy involving Light Form is generally not necessary.
* No Crystal Mask: Players with most or all available buffs and a high level will have a high enough success chance that they no longer need to use Crystal Mask. This allows for AFK times longer than five minutes.

Damage will be taken if the player gets caught before refreshing their pickpocketing, but this can be outhealed by natural life point regeneration if using the above strategies. If your 100% success time is significantly lower than 5 minutes, consider bringing an enhanced Excalibur for additional healing.

The base maximum pickpocketing rate is 3000 per hour if using the Sticky Fingers relic and 2000 per hour otherwise. The master camouflage outfit provides a 7% chance to double the loot, resulting in loot equivalent to 3210 pickpockets per hour, not taking movement into account. For the other camouflage outfits, the chance is 5%. If not using Sticky Fingers, the mushroomy pickpocketing bag has a 5% chance to speed up pickpocketing by one tick, increasing the rate from 2000 to 2034 pickpockets per hour. The experience gain remains roughly the same with or without the Sticky Fingers relic as the experience per pickpocket is adjusted. About a +1% success chance boost is needed with the relic to reach the same AFK times as the change to the success chance decay per pickpocket does not account for the sped up initial bonus success pickpockets.

With sufficiently high Thieving and Agility levels, the player will have a chance to pickpocket multiple loot at once:
* Double loot at 85 Thieving and 75 Agility
* Triple loot at 95 Thieving and 85 Agility
* Quadruple loot at 105 Thieving and 95 Agility
This additional loot is not factored into the above rates as the exact chance to multiply loot is not known. However, it is fairly common.

While requiring additional time, growing and processing the Starbloom flower seeds into Starbloom cloth increases the value of the seeds from to .

activity: Casting High Level Alchemy on onyx bolts (e)
details:
Casting High Level Alchemy on onyx bolts (e) is a low-effort, semi-AFK money making and Magic training method that converts purchased onyx bolts (e) into coins via the High Level Alchemy spell. Because onyx bolts (e) have a high buy limit (11,000 per 4 hours) and a strong alch margin, this is one of the more sustainable high alching targets for stacking up casts without running into Grand Exchange limits.

High Level Alchemy converts an item into coins equal to 60% of its base value, and takes 5 game ticks (3 seconds) to cast, allowing a maximum of 1,200 casts per hour. Equipping a staff of fire or similar fire-providing staff removes the need to supply fire runes, leaving the nature runes as the only consumable cost per cast.

At a Grand Exchange price of 7,233 coins per bolt and a High Alchemy value of 9,000 coins, each cast nets roughly 1,395 coins before the nature rune cost is considered (9,000 − 7,233), with the nature rune (372 coins) bringing per-cast profit to approximately 1,395 coins and an hourly profit of roughly 1.67M coins at maximum cast speed. Profit margins shift constantly with the GE price of both Onyx bolts (e) and nature runes, so check current prices before buying in bulk.

The 11,000-per-4-hour buy limit on Onyx bolts (e) and the 13,000-per-4-hour limit on nature runes both comfortably exceed the 1,200 casts achievable in a single hour, making this method viable for multi-hour sessions without needing to rotate through alternate accounts or items.
